package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.mapper;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.AttemptGraphDto;

/**
 * Сборка ответа с использованием Stream API, distinct по ключу (через TreeSet)
 * для дедупликации и сортировки в одном шаге.
 */
@Component
public class AttemptGraphAssembler {

    private static final Comparator<Runner> BY_BIB =
            Comparator.comparing(Runner::getBib, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    private static final Comparator<Attempt> BY_HELD_AT =
            Comparator.comparing(Attempt::getHeldAt, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()))
                    .thenComparing(Attempt::getId, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    private static final Comparator<SplitTime> BY_LAP =
            Comparator.comparingInt(SplitTime::getLap)
                    .thenComparing(SplitTime::getRecordedAt,
                            Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    public AttemptGraphDto assemble(Attempt attempt, List<Runner> environment) {
        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphRunnerDto> rows = environment.stream()
                .sorted(BY_BIB)
                .map(runner -> new AttemptGraphDto.GraphRunnerDto(
                        runner.getBib(),
                        runner.getFullName(),
                        attemptsOf(runner),
                        splitsOf(runner)
                ))
                .toList();

        return new AttemptGraphDto(attempt.getId(), attempt.getDisciplineCode(), rows);
    }

    private static List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> attemptsOf(Runner runner) {
        // TreeSet использует компаратор BY_HELD_AT для дедупликации и сортировки
        TreeSet<Attempt> sorted = new TreeSet<>(BY_HELD_AT);
        runner.getAttempts().stream()
                .filter(a -> a != null && a.getId() != null)
                .forEach(sorted::add);

        return sorted.stream()
                .map(a -> new AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto(a.getId(), a.getResultMs(), a.getHeldAt()))
                .toList();
    }

    private static List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> splitsOf(Runner runner) {
        TreeSet<SplitTime> sorted = new TreeSet<>(BY_LAP);
        runner.getSplits().stream()
                .filter(s -> s != null && s.getId() != null)
                .forEach(sorted::add);

        return sorted.stream()
                .map(s -> new AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto(s.getLap(), s.getElapsedMs(), s.getCheckpointCode()))
                .toList();
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.mapper;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.AttemptGraphDto;

/**
 * Сборка с предварительным группированием: один проход по всем бегунам,
 * сбор мап attempts и splits заранее, затем сортировка.
 * Минимизирует количество итераций по коллекциям.
 */
@Component
public class AttemptGraphAssembler {

    private static final Comparator<Runner> BY_BIB =
            Comparator.comparing(Runner::getBib, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    private static final Comparator<Attempt> BY_HELD_AT =
            Comparator.comparing(Attempt::getHeldAt, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()))
                    .thenComparing(Attempt::getId, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    private static final Comparator<SplitTime> BY_LAP =
            Comparator.comparingInt(SplitTime::getLap)
                    .thenComparing(SplitTime::getRecordedAt,
                            Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    public AttemptGraphDto assemble(Attempt attempt, List<Runner> environment) {
        // Преобразуем всех бегунов в DTO за один проход, собирая попытки и отсечки
        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphRunnerDto> rows = environment.stream()
                .sorted(BY_BIB)
                .map(runner -> {
                    List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> attempts = buildAttempts(runner);
                    List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> splits = buildSplits(runner);
                    return new AttemptGraphDto.GraphRunnerDto(
                            runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), attempts, splits);
                })
                .toList();

        return new AttemptGraphDto(attempt.getId(), attempt.getDisciplineCode(), rows);
    }

    private List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> buildAttempts(Runner runner) {
        // Дедупликация через HashMap + сортировка через Collections.sort
        Map<Long, Attempt> unique = new HashMap<>();
        for (Attempt a : runner.getAttempts()) {
            if (a != null && a.getId() != null) {
                unique.put(a.getId(), a);
            }
        }
        List<Attempt> list = new ArrayList<>(unique.values());
        list.sort(BY_HELD_AT);

        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> result = new ArrayList<>(list.size());
        for (Attempt a : list) {
            result.add(new AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto(a.getId(), a.getResultMs(), a.getHeldAt()));
        }
        return result;
    }

    private List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> buildSplits(Runner runner) {
        Map<Long, SplitTime> unique = new HashMap<>();
        for (SplitTime s : runner.getSplits()) {
            if (s != null && s.getId() != null) {
                unique.put(s.getId(), s);
            }
        }
        List<SplitTime> list = new ArrayList<>(unique.values());
        list.sort(BY_LAP);

        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> result = new ArrayList<>(list.size());
        for (SplitTime s : list) {
            result.add(new AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto(s.getLap(), s.getElapsedMs(), s.getCheckpointCode()));
        }
        return result;
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.mapper;

import java.util.*;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.AttemptGraphDto;

/**
 * Максимально низкоуровневая реализация: минимум аллокаций,
 * использование примитивных массивов и ручных циклов,
 * дедупликация через HashSet и Arrays.sort.
 */
@Component
public class AttemptGraphAssembler {

    private static final Comparator<Runner> BY_BIB =
            Comparator.comparing(Runner::getBib, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    private static final Comparator<Attempt> BY_HELD_AT =
            Comparator.comparing(Attempt::getHeldAt, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()))
                    .thenComparing(Attempt::getId, Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    private static final Comparator<SplitTime> BY_LAP =
            Comparator.comparingInt(SplitTime::getLap)
                    .thenComparing(SplitTime::getRecordedAt,
                            Comparator.nullsLast(Comparator.naturalOrder()));

    public AttemptGraphDto assemble(Attempt attempt, List<Runner> environment) {
        // Сортировка бегунов и аллокация списка результата
        int size = environment.size();
        Runner[] sortedRunners = environment.toArray(new Runner[0]);
        Arrays.sort(sortedRunners, BY_BIB);

        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphRunnerDto> rows = new ArrayList<>(size);
        for (Runner runner : sortedRunners) {
            List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> attempts = dedupAndSortAttempts(runner);
            List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> splits = dedupAndSortSplits(runner);
            rows.add(new AttemptGraphDto.GraphRunnerDto(
                    runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), attempts, splits));
        }

        return new AttemptGraphDto(attempt.getId(), attempt.getDisciplineCode(), rows);
    }

    private List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> dedupAndSortAttempts(Runner runner) {
        Collection<Attempt> attempts = runner.getAttempts();
        int attemptCount = attempts.size();
        if (attemptCount == 0) return Collections.emptyList();

        // 1. Сбор в массив с дедупликацией
        Set<Long> seenIds = new HashSet<>();
        Attempt[] arr = new Attempt[attemptCount];
        int idx = 0;
        for (Attempt a : attempts) {
            if (a != null && a.getId() != null && seenIds.add(a.getId())) {
                arr[idx++] = a;
            }
        }
        // Обрезаем массив до реальной длины
        Attempt[] unique = idx < attemptCount ? Arrays.copyOf(arr, idx) : arr;

        // 2. Сортировка
        Arrays.sort(unique, BY_HELD_AT);

        // 3. Преобразование в DTO
        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto> result = new ArrayList<>(unique.length);
        for (Attempt a : unique) {
            result.add(new AttemptGraphDto.GraphAttemptDto(a.getId(), a.getResultMs(), a.getHeldAt()));
        }
        return result;
    }

    private List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> dedupAndSortSplits(Runner runner) {
        Collection<SplitTime> splits = runner.getSplits();
        int splitCount = splits.size();
        if (splitCount == 0) return Collections.emptyList();

        Set<Long> seenIds = new HashSet<>();
        SplitTime[] arr = new SplitTime[splitCount];
        int idx = 0;
        for (SplitTime s : splits) {
            if (s != null && s.getId() != null && seenIds.add(s.getId())) {
                arr[idx++] = s;
            }
        }
        SplitTime[] unique = idx < splitCount ? Arrays.copyOf(arr, idx) : arr;

        Arrays.sort(unique, BY_LAP);

        List<AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto> result = new ArrayList<>(unique.length);
        for (SplitTime s : unique) {
            result.add(new AttemptGraphDto.GraphSplitDto(s.getLap(), s.getElapsedMs(), s.getCheckpointCode()));
        }
        return result;
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Variant 1 – single native query with left join, ORDER BY, and LIMIT.
 */
@Service
public class TopAttemptService {

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public TopAttemptService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LeaderRow> top(String disciplineCode, int limit) {
        if (limit <= 0 || disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int effectiveLimit = Math.min(limit, properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());
        String code = disciplineCode.trim();

        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager.createNativeQuery("""
                SELECT s.elapsed_ms, s.runner_id, r.bib
                FROM split_time s
                LEFT JOIN runner r ON r.id = s.runner_id
                WHERE s.discipline_code = :code
                ORDER BY s.elapsed_ms ASC, s.runner_id ASC
                LIMIT :lim
                """)
                .setParameter("code", code)
                .setParameter("lim", effectiveLimit)
                .getResultList();

        // Use existing static factory LeaderRow.of(SplitTime, String) – but we don't have SplitTime instances.
        // Instead, we create a temporary SplitTime with only the required fields.
        List<LeaderRow> result = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            long elapsedMs = ((Number) row[0]).longValue();
            long runnerId = row[1] != null ? ((Number) row[1]).longValue() : 0L;
            String bib = (String) row[2];
            // Construct a lightweight SplitTime stub (elapsedMs + runnerId only)
            SplitTime stub = new SplitTime();
            stub.setElapsedMs(elapsedMs);
            stub.setRunnerId(runnerId);
            result.add(LeaderRow.of(stub, bib));
        }
        return result;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long splitsOf(String disciplineCode) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return 0L;
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.countByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Variant 2 – min‑heap selection of top N, batch bib fetch.
 */
@Service
public class TopAttemptService {

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public TopAttemptService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LeaderRow> top(String disciplineCode, int limit) {
        if (limit <= 0 || disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int effectiveLimit = Math.min(limit, properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());

        List<SplitTime> all = splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());

        // Use priority queue (min‑heap) to keep only the top effectiveLimit elements
        PriorityQueue<SplitTime> heap = new PriorityQueue<>(Math.max(effectiveLimit, 8),
                Comparator.comparingLong(SplitTime::getElapsedMs)
                        .thenComparing(SplitTime::getRunnerId).reversed());

        for (SplitTime s : all) {
            heap.offer(s);
            if (heap.size() > effectiveLimit) {
                heap.poll();
            }
        }

        // Extract in ascending order
        List<SplitTime> selected = new ArrayList<>(heap.size());
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            selected.add(heap.poll());
        }
        Collections.reverse(selected);

        // Batch fetch bibs – same as original, using a HashSet for runnerIds
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(selected);

        List<LeaderRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(selected.size());
        for (SplitTime split : selected) {
            rows.add(LeaderRow.of(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOf(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            if (split.getRunnerId() != null) {
                runnerIds.add(split.getRunnerId());
            }
        }
        if (runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Map<Long, String> bibs = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size());
        for (Object[] pair : runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(runnerIds)) {
            bibs.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return bibs;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long splitsOf(String disciplineCode) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return 0L;
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.countByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Variant 3 – primitive arrays, custom quicksort, minimal allocation.
 */
@Service
public class TopAttemptService {

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public TopAttemptService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LeaderRow> top(String disciplineCode, int limit) {
        if (limit <= 0 || disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int effectiveLimit = Math.min(limit, properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());

        List<SplitTime> all = splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
        int n = all.size();
        if (n == 0) {
            return List.of();
        }

        // Build primitive arrays
        long[] elapsed = new long[n];
        long[] runnerId = new long[n];
        int[] indices = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            SplitTime s = all.get(i);
            elapsed[i] = s.getElapsedMs();
            runnerId[i] = s.getRunnerId() == null ? Long.MAX_VALUE : s.getRunnerId();
            indices[i] = i;
        }

        // Sort indices using dual‑pivot quicksort with custom primitive comparator
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> {
            int cmp = Long.compare(elapsed[a], elapsed[b]);
            if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
            return Long.compare(runnerId[a], runnerId[b]);
        });

        // Take top effectiveLimit
        List<SplitTime> selected = new ArrayList<>(effectiveLimit);
        for (int k = 0; k < effectiveLimit && k < n; k++) {
            selected.add(all.get(indices[k]));
        }

        // Batch bib fetch (same infrastructure)
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(selected);

        List<LeaderRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(selected.size());
        for (SplitTime split : selected) {
            rows.add(LeaderRow.of(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOf(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            if (split.getRunnerId() != null) {
                runnerIds.add(split.getRunnerId());
            }
        }
        if (runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Map<Long, String> bibs = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size());
        for (Object[] pair : runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(runnerIds)) {
            bibs.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return bibs;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long splitsOf(String disciplineCode) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return 0L;
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.countByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.TypedQuery;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;

/**
 * Вариант 1: Используем EntityManager с DTO-проекцией через конструктор,
 * чтобы получить только нужные поля и избежать страничных запросов.
 * Данные читаются одним потокобезопасным курсором с лимитом {@link #maxRows}.
 * Запись ведётся в переиспользуемый байтовый массив.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;
    private static final Sort EXPORT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "heldAt")
            .and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final EntityManager entityManager;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                EntityManager entityManager,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.entityManager = entityManager;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank())
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        // DTO проекция через конструктор record
        String jpql = """
            SELECT new ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export.AttemptExportService$AttemptRecord(
                a.bib, a.resultMs
            )
            FROM Attempt a
            WHERE a.disciplineCode = :dc AND a.heldAt BETWEEN :from AND :to
            ORDER BY a.heldAt ASC, a.id ASC
            """;

        TypedQuery<AttemptRecord> query = entityManager.createQuery(jpql, AttemptRecord.class);
        query.setParameter("dc", disciplineCode);
        query.setParameter("from", from);
        query.setParameter("to", to);
        query.setMaxResults(maxRows);

        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(maxRows * RECORD_BYTES);
        // Переиспользуемый буфер для одной записи
        byte[] recordBuffer = new byte[RECORD_BYTES];

        for (AttemptRecord row : query.getResultList()) {
            // Кодируем биб напрямую в буфер
            byte[] bibBytes = row.bib == null ? new byte[0] : row.bib.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            int copyLen = Math.min(bibBytes.length, BIB_BYTES);
            System.arraycopy(bibBytes, 0, recordBuffer, 0, copyLen);
            // Остаток буфера остаётся нулевым (массив инициализирован нулями)
            // Большой целый (resultMs) – big-endian
            long ms = row.resultMs;
            recordBuffer[16] = (byte) (ms >>> 56);
            recordBuffer[17] = (byte) (ms >>> 48);
            recordBuffer[18] = (byte) (ms >>> 40);
            recordBuffer[19] = (byte) (ms >>> 32);
            recordBuffer[20] = (byte) (ms >>> 24);
            recordBuffer[21] = (byte) (ms >>> 16);
            recordBuffer[22] = (byte) (ms >>> 8);
            recordBuffer[23] = (byte) (ms);
            sink.writeBytes(recordBuffer);
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    public record AttemptRecord(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;

/**
 * Вариант 2: Пакетная обработка страниц – все строки одной страницы
 * помещаются в один ByteBuffer, который затем целиком сбрасывается в поток.
 * Уменьшается число вызовов sink.writeBytes и перераспределений памяти.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;
    private static final int PAGE_ROWS = 5_000;
    private static final Sort EXPORT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "heldAt")
            .and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank())
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(PAGE_ROWS * RECORD_BYTES);
        int written = 0;
        int pageNumber = 0;
        boolean hasMore = true;

        while (hasMore && written < maxRows) {
            Page<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> page = attemptRepository
                    .findViewByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(disciplineCode, from, to,
                            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, PAGE_ROWS, EXPORT_ORDER));
            List<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> rows = page.getContent();
            int rowsToProcess = Math.min(rows.size(), maxRows - written);
            if (rowsToProcess == 0) break;

            // Один большой ByteBuffer на всю страницу
            ByteBuffer pageBuffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(rowsToProcess * RECORD_BYTES);
            for (int i = 0; i < rowsToProcess; i++) {
                AttemptRepository.AttemptView row = rows.get(i);
                byte[] bibBytes = row.getBib() == null ? new byte[0] : row.getBib().getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
                int copyLen = Math.min(bibBytes.length, BIB_BYTES);
                pageBuffer.put(bibBytes, 0, copyLen);
                pageBuffer.position(pageBuffer.position() + (BIB_BYTES - copyLen)); // пропуск остатка
                pageBuffer.putLong(row.getResultMs());
            }
            pageBuffer.flip();
            sink.writeBytes(pageBuffer.array(), 0, pageBuffer.remaining());
            written += rowsToProcess;

            hasMore = page.hasNext();
            pageNumber++;
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

        boolean hasMore = true;

        while (hasMore && written < maxRows) {
            Page<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> page = attemptRepository
                    .findViewByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(disciplineCode, from, to,
                            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, PAGE_ROWS, EXPORT_ORDER));
            List<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> rows = page.getContent();
            for (AttemptRepository.AttemptView row : rows) {
                if (written == maxRows) break;
                // Получаем буфер текущего потока (переиспользуемый)
                byte[] buf = RECORD_BUFFER.get();
                // Обнуление (нужно только для bib-части, long выставляется целиком)
                // Можно сбросить только те байты, которые могут быть не перезаписаны
                // (первые BIB_BYTES)
                java.util.Arrays.fill(buf, 0, BIB_BYTES, (byte) 0);

                // Кодируем bib напрямую в буфер через CharsetEncoder – без промежуточных byte[]
                String bib = row.getBib();
                if (bib != null && !bib.isEmpty()) {
                    try {
                        java.nio.CharBuffer cb = java.nio.CharBuffer.wrap(bib);
                        java.nio.ByteBuffer encoded = UTF8_ENCODER.encode(cb);
                        int len = Math.min(encoded.remaining(), BIB_BYTES);
                        encoded.get(buf, 0, len);
                    } catch (CharacterCodingException e) {
                        // невозможно для UTF-8, игнорируем
                    }
                }
                // Результат в миллисекундах (big-endian) – ручная запись
                long ms = row.getResultMs();
                buf[16] = (byte) (ms >>> 56);
                buf[17] = (byte) (ms >>> 48);
                buf[18] = (byte) (ms >>> 40);
                buf[19] = (byte) (ms >>> 32);
                buf[20] = (byte) (ms >>> 24);
                buf[21] = (byte) (ms >>> 16);
                buf[22] = (byte) (ms >>> 8);
                buf[23] = (byte) (ms);
                sink.writeBytes(buf);
                written++;
            }
            hasMore = page.hasNext();
            pageNumber++;
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Slice;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;

/**
 * Двоичная выгрузка попыток за окно для внешней системы протоколов.
 *
 * <p>Оптимизация: использование {@link Slice} вместо {@link org.springframework.data.domain.Page}
 * для устранения дорогостоящего count-запроса при пагинации.
 * Применяется проекция интерфейса {@link AttemptRepository.AttemptView}.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;
    private static final int PAGE_ROWS = 5_000;
    private static final Sort EXPORT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "heldAt")
            .and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Slice-пагинация: без count-запроса, только hasNext. */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(PAGE_ROWS * RECORD_BYTES);
        int written = 0;
        int pageNumber = 0;
        boolean hasMore = true;
        while (hasMore && written < maxRows) {
            Slice<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> slice = attemptRepository
                    .findSliceByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(disciplineCode, from, to,
                            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, PAGE_ROWS, EXPORT_ORDER));
            List<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> rows = slice.getContent();
            for (AttemptRepository.AttemptView row : rows) {
                if (written == maxRows) break;
                sink.writeBytes(record(row.getBib(), row.getResultMs()));
                written++;
            }
            hasMore = slice.hasNext();
            pageNumber++;
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] record(String bib, long resultMs) {
        ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(RECORD_BYTES);
        byte[] name = bib == null ? new byte[0] : bib.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        buffer.put(name, 0, Math.min(name.length, BIB_BYTES));
        buffer.position(BIB_BYTES);
        buffer.putLong(resultMs);
        return buffer.array();
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Bulk-запрос всех строк в одном списке + кэш bib-байтов. */

            recordBuffer.put(bibBytes, 0, copyLen);
            recordBuffer.position(BIB_BYTES);
            recordBuffer.putLong(resultMs);
            sink.writeBytes(recordBuffer.array());
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export;

import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.ByteBuffer;
import java.nio.charset.CharsetEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;

/**
 * Двоичная выгрузка попыток за окно для внешней системы протоколов.
 *
 * <p>Оптимизация нулевого аллоцирования на запись: статический {@link CharsetEncoder},
 * переиспользуемый {@link ByteBuffer} для одной страницы, прямая запись в массив
 * минуя промежуточный {@code byte[]} для bib.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;
    private static final int PAGE_ROWS = 5_000;
    private static final Sort EXPORT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "heldAt")
            .and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));

    private static final CharsetEncoder UTF8_ENCODER = StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newEncoder();
    private static final byte[] ZERO_PAD = new byte[BIB_BYTES];

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Запись с переиспользуемым ByteBuffer и прямым кодированием bib. */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(PAGE_ROWS * RECORD_BYTES);
        int written = 0;
        int pageNumber = 0;
        boolean hasMore = true;

        // Переиспользуемый буфер для одной страницы
        byte[] pageBuffer = new byte[PAGE_ROWS * RECORD_BYTES];
        ByteBuffer buf = ByteBuffer.wrap(pageBuffer);

        while (hasMore && written < maxRows) {
            Page<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> page = attemptRepository
                    .findViewByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(disciplineCode, from, to,
                            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, PAGE_ROWS, EXPORT_ORDER));
            List<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> rows = page.getContent();
            buf.clear();

            for (AttemptRepository.AttemptView row : rows) {
                if (written == maxRows) break;
                int startPos = buf.position();
                // Прямое кодирование bib в буфер (без создания промежуточного byte[])
                if (row.getBib() != null) {
                    buf.limit(startPos + BIB_BYTES);
                    UTF8_ENCODER.reset();
                    UTF8_ENCODER.encode(java.nio.CharBuffer.wrap(row.getBib()), buf, true);
                    int endPos = buf.position();
                    // Дополняем нулями до BIB_BYTES
                    if (endPos - startPos < BIB_BYTES) {
                        buf.position(endPos);
                        buf.put(ZERO_PAD, 0, BIB_BYTES - (endPos - startPos));
                    }
                } else {
                    // нулевой bib
                    buf.put(ZERO_PAD);
                }
                buf.position(startPos + BIB_BYTES);
                buf.putLong(row.getResultMs());
                written++;
            }
            int bytesWritten = buf.position();
            sink.write(pageBuffer, 0, bytesWritten);

            hasMore = page.hasNext();
            pageNumber++;
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] record(String bib, long resultMs) {
        // Не используется, сохранён для совместимости API
        throw new UnsupportedOperationException("Deprecated");
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.mapper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.SplitDto;

/**
 * Перенос отсечек хронометража в представление ответа API.
 *
 * <p>Отсечка хранит бегуна идентификатором, а наружу отдаётся стартовый номер. Номера всех бегунов
 * страницы разрешаются одним обращением к заявке: на строку отдельного обращения нет.
 */
@Component
public class SplitDtoMapper {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;

    public SplitDtoMapper(RunnerRepository runnerRepository) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
    }

    /**
     * Представление страницы отсечек.
     *
     * @param page страница отсечек
     * @return страница отсечек для ответа API в том же порядке
     */
    public Page<SplitDto> toPage(Page<SplitTime> page) {
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(page.getContent());
        return page.map(split -> toDto(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
    }

    /**
     * Представление списка отсечек.
     *
     * @param splits отсечки хронометража
     * @return отсечки для ответа API в том же порядке
     */
    public List<SplitDto> toDtoList(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(splits);
        var content = new ArrayList<SplitDto>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            content.add(toDto(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
        }
        return content;
    }

    /** Представление одной отсечки с уже разрешённым стартовым номером. */
    private static SplitDto toDto(SplitTime split, String bib) {
        return new SplitDto(split.getId(), bib, split.getDisciplineCode(), split.getLap(),
                split.getElapsedMs(), split.getRecordedAt(), split.getCheckpointCode());
    }

    /** Стартовые номера бегунов, встречающихся в выборке, по их идентификаторам. */
    private Map<Long, String> bibsOf(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        // Собираем множество runnerId (порядок не важен)
        var runnerIds = splits.stream()
                .map(SplitTime::getRunnerId)
                .filter(id -> id != null)
                .collect(Collectors.toSet());

        if (runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }

        // Делегируем построение Map репозиторию (метод возвращает уже готовую карту)
        return runnerRepository.findBibMapByIds(runnerIds);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.mapper;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.SplitDto;

/**
 * Перенос отсечек хронометража в представление ответа API.
 *
 * <p>Отсечка хранит бегуна идентификатором, а наружу отдаётся стартовый номер. Номера всех бегунов
 * страницы разрешаются одним обращением к заявке: на строку отдельного обращения нет.
 */
@Component
public class SplitDtoMapper {

    // Простая хэш-таблица с открытой адресацией для long → String
    private static final class LongStringHashMap {
        private long[] keys;
        private String[] values;
        private int size;
        private int capacity;
        private static final int DEFAULT_CAPACITY = 16;

        LongStringHashMap(int initialCapacity) {
            capacity = nextPowerOfTwo(initialCapacity * 2);
            keys = new long[capacity];
            values = new String[capacity];
            Arrays.fill(keys, Long.MIN_VALUE); // маркер пустого слота
        }

        void put(long key, String value) {
            if (size >= capacity * 0.75) {
                resize();
            }
            int idx = index(key);
            while (keys[idx] != Long.MIN_VALUE && keys[idx] != key) {
                idx = (idx + 1) & (capacity - 1);
            }
            if (keys[idx] == Long.MIN_VALUE) {
                keys[idx] = key;
                size++;
            }
            values[idx] = value;
        }

        String get(long key) {
            int idx = index(key);
            while (keys[idx] != Long.MIN_VALUE) {
                if (keys[idx] == key) {
                    return values[idx];
                }
                idx = (idx + 1) & (capacity - 1);
            }
            return null;
        }

        private int index(long key) {
            return (int) (key ^ (key >>> 33)) & (capacity - 1); // simple mix
        }

        private void resize() {
            int newCapacity = capacity * 2;
            long[] oldKeys = keys;
            String[] oldValues = values;
            keys = new long[newCapacity];
            values = new String[newCapacity];
            Arrays.fill(keys, Long.MIN_VALUE);
            capacity = newCapacity;
            size = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
                long k = oldKeys[i];
                if (k != Long.MIN_VALUE) {
                    put(k, oldValues[i]);
                }
            }
        }

        private static int nextPowerOfTwo(int x) {
            int highestOneBit = Integer.highestOneBit(x);
            return (highestOneBit == x) ? x : highestOneBit << 1;
        }
    }

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;

    public SplitDtoMapper(RunnerRepository runnerRepository) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
    }

    /**
     * Представление страницы отсечек.
     *
     * @param page страница отсечек
     * @return страница отсечек для ответа API в том же порядке
     */
    public Page<SplitDto> toPage(Page<SplitTime> page) {
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(page.getContent());
        return page.map(split -> toDto(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
    }

    /**
     * Представление списка отсечек.
     *
     * @param splits отсечки хронометража
     * @return отсечки для ответа API в том же порядке
     */
    public List<SplitDto> toDtoList(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(splits);
        var content = new ArrayList<SplitDto>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            content.add(toDto(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
        }
        return content;
    }

    /** Представление одной отсечки с уже разрешённым стартовым номером. */
    private static SplitDto toDto(SplitTime split, String bib) {
        return new SplitDto(split.getId(), bib, split.getDisciplineCode(), split.getLap(),
                split.getElapsedMs(), split.getRecordedAt(), split.getCheckpointCode());
    }

    /** Стартовые номера бегунов, встречающихся в выборке, по их идентификаторам. */
    private Map<Long, String> bibsOf(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        // Используем HashSet<Long> для уникальных идентификаторов (неизбежное boxing, но компактно)
        var runnerIdsSet = new HashSet<Long>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            Long runnerId = split.getRunnerId();
            if (runnerId != null) {
                runnerIdsSet.add(runnerId);
            }
        }
        if (runnerIdsSet.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }

        // Запрашиваем из БД сырые пары (id, bib)
        List<Object[]> pairs = runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(runnerIdsSet);

        // Кладём результат в кастомную low‑overhead хэш‑таблицу (без Long‑обёрток)
        var bibMap = new LongStringHashMap(pairs.size());
        for (Object[] pair : pairs) {
            bibMap.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }

        // Возвращаем обёртку, чтобы реализовывать Map<Long, String>
        return new Map<>() {
            @Override
            public int size() { return pairs.size(); }

            @Override
            public boolean isEmpty() { return pairs.isEmpty(); }

            @Override
            public boolean containsKey(Object key) {
                return key instanceof Long && bibMap.get((Long) key) != null;
            }

            @Override
            public boolean containsValue(Object value) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public String get(Object key) {
                return (key instanceof Long) ? bibMap.get((Long) key) : null;
            }

            @Override
            public String put(Long key, String value) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public String remove(Object key) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public void putAll(Map<? extends Long, ? extends String> m) { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public void clear() { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public Set<Long> keySet() { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public java.util.Collection<String> values() { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }

            @Override
            public Set<Entry<Long, String>> entrySet() { throw new UnsupportedOperationException(); }
        };
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.TypedQuery;
import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.model.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;

/**
 * Бинарная выгрузка попыток с использованием {@link EntityManager} для
 * JPQL-запроса с конструкцией {@code SELECT new …} и явным ограничением
 * {@code maxResults}. Это сокращает количество запросов к БД до одного
 * и избавляет от создания прокси-объектов Spring Data.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final EntityManager entityManager;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties,
                                EntityManager entityManager) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.entityManager = entityManager;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank())
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Единый запрос с JPQL-конструктором и LIMIT = maxRows. */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        TypedQuery<AttemptRecord> query = entityManager.createQuery(
                "SELECT new ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export.AttemptExportService$AttemptRecord(" +
                        "a.bib, a.resultMs) " +
                        "FROM Attempt a " +
                        "WHERE a.disciplineCode = :code AND a.heldAt BETWEEN :from AND :to " +
                        "ORDER BY a.heldAt, a.id",
                AttemptRecord.class);
        query.setParameter("code", disciplineCode);
        query.setParameter("from", from);
        query.setParameter("to", to);
        query.setMaxResults(maxRows);

        List<AttemptRecord> rows = query.getResultList();
        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(rows.size() * RECORD_BYTES);
        for (AttemptRecord row : rows) {
            sink.writeBytes(record(row.bib(), row.resultMs()));
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    /** Запись фиксированной длины: 16 байт номера + 8 байт результата. */
    private static byte[] record(String bib, long resultMs) {
        var buffer = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(RECORD_BYTES);
        byte[] name = (bib == null) ? new byte[0] : bib.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        buffer.put(name, 0, Math.min(name.length, BIB_BYTES));
        buffer.position(BIB_BYTES);
        buffer.putLong(resultMs);
        return buffer.array();
    }

    /** DTO-запись для JPQL-конструктора. */
    public record AttemptRecord(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

 * на стороне запроса. Курсор забирает строки по одному фрагменту (1000 строк),
 * не загружая всю выборку в память и не выполняя многократных запросов.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;

    private static final int STREAM_BATCH_SIZE = 1000;

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final EntityManager entityManager;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties,
                                EntityManager entityManager) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.entityManager = entityManager;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank())
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Один запрос с потоком, ограниченным {@code maxRows}. */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        TypedQuery<Attempt> query = entityManager.createQuery(
                "SELECT a FROM Attempt a " +
                        "WHERE a.disciplineCode = :code AND a.heldAt BETWEEN :from AND :to " +
                        "ORDER BY a.heldAt, a.id",
                Attempt.class);
        query.setParameter("code", disciplineCode);
        query.setParameter("from", from);
        query.setParameter("to", to);
        query.setHint(QueryHints.HINT_FETCH_SIZE, STREAM_BATCH_SIZE);
        query.setMaxResults(maxRows);

        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(PAGE_ROWS * RECORD_BYTES);
        try (Stream<Attempt> stream = query.getResultStream()) {
            long count = stream
                    .limit(maxRows)
                    .peek(a -> sink.writeBytes(record(a.getBib(), a.getResultMs())))
                    .count();
            // Докинуть до maxRows, если строк меньше
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] record(String bib, long resultMs) {
        var buffer = java.nio.ByteBuffer.allocate(RECORD_BYTES);
        byte[] name = (bib == null) ? new byte[0] : bib.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        buffer.put(name, 0, Math.min(name.length, BIB_BYTES));
        buffer.position(BIB_BYTES);
        buffer.putLong(resultMs);
        return buffer.array();
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.export;

import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Optional;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;

/**
 * Низкоуровневая выгрузка без промежуточных аллокаций:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>Предвычисление количества строк (count) для точного выделения массива</li>
 *   <li>Многократное использование одного массива {@code byte[RECORD_BYTES]}</li>
 *   <li>Ручная сериализация long (без {@code ByteBuffer})</li>
 * </ul>
 */
@Service
public class AttemptExportService {

    public static final int RECORD_BYTES = 24;
    public static final int BIB_BYTES = 16;

    private static final byte[] ZERO_PADDING = new byte[BIB_BYTES];

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore;
    private final int maxRows;

    public AttemptExportService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                ExportTokenStore exportTokenStore,
                                AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.exportTokenStore = exportTokenStore;
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank())
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /**
     * Сначала выполняется быстрый count, чтобы точно рассчитать размер массива.
     * Затем все строки загружаются одной страницей (page size = count but capped by maxRows).
     * Каждая строка записывается без промежуточных объектов.
     */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        // 1. Быстрый подсчёт строк (детерминированная операция)
        int total = (int) attemptRepository.countByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(disciplineCode, from, to);
        int rowsToWrite = Math.min(total, maxRows);

        // 2. Точное выделение массива
        byte[] output = new byte[rowsToWrite * RECORD_BYTES];
        if (rowsToWrite == 0) {
            return output;
        }

        // 3. Однократная загрузка всех строк (единый запрос с LIMIT)
        var page = attemptRepository.findViewByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(
                disciplineCode, from, to,
                org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest.of(0, rowsToWrite,
                        org.springframework.data.domain.Sort.by("heldAt", "id").ascending()));
        var rows = page.getContent();

        // 4. Запись в выходной массив без аллокаций
        int offset = 0;
        byte[] rowBuffer = new byte[RECORD_BYTES]; // переиспользуемый буфер
        for (var row : rows) {
            writeRecord(row.getBib(), row.getResultMs(), rowBuffer);
            System.arraycopy(rowBuffer, 0, output, offset, RECORD_BYTES);
            offset += RECORD_BYTES;
        }
        return output;
    }

    /** Заполняет переданный буфер данными одной попытки. */
    private static void writeRecord(String bib, long resultMs, byte[] buf) {
        // 1. Обнуление буфера (заполнение нулями для номера)
        Arrays.fill(buf, (byte) 0);

        // 2. Копирование номера (UTF-8, обрезка до 16 байт)
        if (bib != null && !bib.isEmpty()) {
            byte[] nameBytes = bib.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
            int len = Math.min(nameBytes.length, BIB_BYTES);
            System.arraycopy(nameBytes, 0, buf, 0, len);
        }

        // 3. Запись результата (8 байт, big‑endian) вручную
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 0] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 56);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 1] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 48);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 2] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 40);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 3] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 32);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 4] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 24);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 5] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 16);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 6] = (byte) (resultMs >>> 8);
        buf[BIB_BYTES + 7] = (byte) (resultMs);
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

/**
 * Variant 1 – single native query with left join, ORDER BY, and LIMIT.
 */
@Service
public class TopAttemptService {

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public TopAttemptService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LeaderRow> top(String disciplineCode, int limit) {
        if (limit <= 0 || disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int effectiveLimit = Math.min(limit, properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());
        String code = disciplineCode.trim();

        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager.createNativeQuery("""
                SELECT s.elapsed_ms, s.runner_id, r.bib
                FROM split_time s
                LEFT JOIN runner r ON r.id = s.runner_id
                WHERE s.discipline_code = :code
                ORDER BY s.elapsed_ms ASC, s.runner_id ASC
                LIMIT :lim
                """)
                .setParameter("code", code)
                .setParameter("lim", effectiveLimit)
                .getResultList();

        // Use existing static factory LeaderRow.of(SplitTime, String) – but we don't have SplitTime instances.
        // Instead, we create a temporary SplitTime with only the required fields.
        List<LeaderRow> result = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            long elapsedMs = ((Number) row[0]).longValue();
            long runnerId = row[1] != null ? ((Number) row[1]).longValue() : 0L;
            String bib = (String) row[2];
            // Construct a lightweight SplitTime stub (elapsedMs + runnerId only)
            SplitTime stub = new SplitTime();
            stub.setElapsedMs(elapsedMs);
            stub.setRunnerId(runnerId);
            result.add(LeaderRow.of(stub, bib));
        }
        return result;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long splitsOf(String disciplineCode) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return 0L;
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.countByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import java.util.*;

/**
 * Variant 2 – min‑heap selection of top N, batch bib fetch.
 */
@Service
public class TopAttemptService {

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public TopAttemptService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LeaderRow> top(String disciplineCode, int limit) {
        if (limit <= 0 || disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int effectiveLimit = Math.min(limit, properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());

        List<SplitTime> all = splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());

        // Use priority queue (min‑heap) to keep only the top effectiveLimit elements
        PriorityQueue<SplitTime> heap = new PriorityQueue<>(Math.max(effectiveLimit, 8),
                Comparator.comparingLong(SplitTime::getElapsedMs)
                        .thenComparing(SplitTime::getRunnerId).reversed());

        for (SplitTime s : all) {
            heap.offer(s);
            if (heap.size() > effectiveLimit) {
                heap.poll();
            }
        }

        // Extract in ascending order
        List<SplitTime> selected = new ArrayList<>(heap.size());
        while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
            selected.add(heap.poll());
        }
        Collections.reverse(selected);

        // Batch fetch bibs – same as original, using a HashSet for runnerIds
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(selected);

        List<LeaderRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(selected.size());
        for (SplitTime split : selected) {
            rows.add(LeaderRow.of(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOf(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            if (split.getRunnerId() != null) {
                runnerIds.add(split.getRunnerId());
            }
        }
        if (runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Map<Long, String> bibs = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size());
        for (Object[] pair : runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(runnerIds)) {
            bibs.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return bibs;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long splitsOf(String disciplineCode) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return 0L;
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.countByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
    }
}

public class TopAttemptService {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public TopAttemptService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public List<LeaderRow> top(String disciplineCode, int limit) {
        if (limit <= 0 || disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return List.of();
        }
        int effectiveLimit = Math.min(limit, properties.getLimits().getTopMaxLimit());

        List<SplitTime> all = splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
        int n = all.size();
        if (n == 0) {
            return List.of();
        }

        // Build primitive arrays
        long[] elapsed = new long[n];
        long[] runnerId = new long[n];
        int[] indices = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            SplitTime s = all.get(i);
            elapsed[i] = s.getElapsedMs();
            runnerId[i] = s.getRunnerId() == null ? Long.MAX_VALUE : s.getRunnerId();
            indices[i] = i;
        }

        // Sort indices using dual‑pivot quicksort with custom primitive comparator
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> {
            int cmp = Long.compare(elapsed[a], elapsed[b]);
            if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
            return Long.compare(runnerId[a], runnerId[b]);
        });

        // Take top effectiveLimit
        List<SplitTime> selected = new ArrayList<>(effectiveLimit);
        for (int k = 0; k < effectiveLimit && k < n; k++) {
            selected.add(all.get(indices[k]));
        }

        // Batch bib fetch (same infrastructure)
        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOf(selected);

        List<LeaderRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(selected.size());
        for (SplitTime split : selected) {
            rows.add(LeaderRow.of(split, bibs.get(split.getRunnerId())));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOf(List<SplitTime> splits) {
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>(splits.size());
        for (SplitTime split : splits) {
            if (split.getRunnerId() != null) {
                runnerIds.add(split.getRunnerId());
            }
        }
        if (runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Map<Long, String> bibs = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size());
        for (Object[] pair : runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(runnerIds)) {
            bibs.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return bibs;
    }

    public long splitsOf(String disciplineCode) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return 0L;
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.countByDisciplineCode(disciplineCode.trim());
    }
}

        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;

        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getExportMaxRows();
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public ExportPayload export(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                String clientTag, String clientAgent) {
        ExportToken token = ExportToken.of(clientTag);
        Optional<ExportMeta> previous = exportTokenStore.find(token);

        byte[] content = disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()
                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Slice-пагинация: без count-запроса, только hasNext. */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        ByteArrayOutputStream sink = new ByteArrayOutputStream(PAGE_ROWS * RECORD_BYTES);
        int written = 0;
        int pageNumber = 0;
        boolean hasMore = true;
        while (hasMore && written < maxRows) {
            Slice<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> slice = attemptRepository
                    .findSliceByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(disciplineCode, from, to,
                            PageRequest.of(pageNumber, PAGE_ROWS, EXPORT_ORDER));
            List<AttemptRepository.AttemptView> rows = slice.getContent();
            for (AttemptRepository.AttemptView row : rows) {
                if (written == maxRows) break;
                sink.writeBytes(record(row.getBib(), row.getResultMs()));
                written++;
            }
            hasMore = slice.hasNext();
            pageNumber++;
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] record(String bib, long resultMs) {
        ByteBuffer buffer = ByteBuffer.allocate(RECORD_BYTES);
        byte[] name = bib == null ? new byte[0] : bib.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        buffer.put(name, 0, Math.min(name.length, BIB_BYTES));
        buffer.position(BIB_BYTES);
        buffer.putLong(resultMs);
        return buffer.array();
    }

    public record ExportPayload(byte[] content, int rows, boolean repeated, long previousBytesSent) {}
}

 */
@Service

                ? new byte[0]
                : writeRecords(disciplineCode.trim(), from, to);
        int rows = content.length / RECORD_BYTES;

        exportTokenStore.remember(token, clientAgent, content.length);
        return new ExportPayload(content, rows, previous.isPresent(),
                previous.map(ExportMeta::bytesSent).orElse(-1L));
    }

    /** Bulk-запрос всех строк в одном списке + кэш bib-байтов. */
    private byte[] writeRecords(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {

                .findAllByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenOrderByHeldAtAscIdAsc(

            recordBuffer.position(BIB_BYTES);
            recordBuffer.putLong(resultMs);
            sink.writeBytes(recordBuffer.array());
        }
        return sink.toByteArray();
    }

    private static byte[] record(String bib, long resultMs) {
        // Не используется, сохранён для совместимости API
