package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.upload;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionTemplate;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.UploadBatch;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.UploadBatchRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.validation.PayloadTypeChecker;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Приём протокола хронометража — вариант с минимальными аллокациями.
 * - Предварительно скомпилированный {@link Pattern} для разделителя.
 * - Набор кодов дисциплин загружается один раз при старте и хранится в статическом final поле.
 * - Разбор строк выполняется вручную через {@code indexOf} и {@code substring}, избегая {@code split()}.
 * - Упрощено приведение типов для elapsedMs (сразу парсится как long).
 */
@Service
public class UploadService {

    // … все константы без изменений …
    private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(UploadService.class);
    public static final String MODE_READ = "read";
    public static final String MODE_DRAIN = "drain";
    public static final String MODE_ALL = "all";
    public static final String STATE_RUNNING = "RUNNING";
    public static final String STATE_DONE = "DONE";
    public static final String STATE_FAILED = "FAILED";
    public static final String REJECT_ELAPSED = "ELAPSED_NOT_NUMERIC";
    public static final String REJECT_DISCIPLINE = "DISCIPLINE_NOT_FOUND";
    public static final String REJECT_COLUMNS = "COLUMN_COUNT";
    public static final String REJECT_LAP = "LAP_NOT_NUMERIC";
    public static final String REJECT_STAMP = "STAMP_NOT_PARSED";
    public static final int DRAIN_BATCH_ROWS = 200_000;
    private static final int ERROR_REPORT_LIMIT = 100;
    private static final int COLUMNS = 6;
    private static final String HEADER_PREFIX = "bib,";

    // Скомпилированный шаблон для разделителя (избегаем компиляции в каждом вызове split)
    private static final Pattern COMMA_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(",");

    // Статический кэш кодов дисциплин (загружается один раз при создании первого экземпляра)
    private static Set<String> DISCIPLINE_CODES_CACHE = null;
    private static final Object LOCK = new Object();

    private final UploadReader uploadReader;
    private final PayloadTypeChecker payloadTypeChecker;
    private final UploadBatchRepository uploadBatchRepository;
    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;
    private final TransactionTemplate transactionTemplate;
    private final Timer readTimer;
    private final Timer parseTimer;
    private final int maxRows;

    public UploadService(UploadReader uploadReader,
                         PayloadTypeChecker payloadTypeChecker,
                         UploadBatchRepository uploadBatchRepository,
                         DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository,
                         PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager,
                         MeterRegistry meterRegistry,
                         AppProperties properties) {
        this.uploadReader = uploadReader;
        this.payloadTypeChecker = payloadTypeChecker;
        this.uploadBatchRepository = uploadBatchRepository;
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;
        this.transactionTemplate = new TransactionTemplate(transactionManager);
        this.readTimer = Timer.builder("upload.read")
                .description("чтение входного файла протокола").register(meterRegistry);
        this.parseTimer = Timer.builder("upload.parse")
                .description("разбор строк входного протокола").register(meterRegistry);
        this.maxRows = properties.getLimits().getUploadMaxRows();
        // Инициализация статического кэша (только один раз)
        synchronized (LOCK) {
            if (DISCIPLINE_CODES_CACHE == null) {
                List<Discipline> all = disciplineRepository.findAllByOrderByCodeAsc();
                Set<String> codes = new HashSet<>(all.size() * 2);
                for (Discipline d : all) {
                    codes.add(d.getCode());
                }
                DISCIPLINE_CODES_CACHE = Collections.unmodifiableSet(codes);
                log.info("Загружены коды дисциплин (статический кэш, {} записей)", codes.size());
            }
        }
    }

    /** Возвращает статический кэш кодов дисциплин (без обращения к БД). */
    private Set<String> disciplineCodes() {
        return DISCIPLINE_CODES_CACHE;
    }

    /** Разбор строки вручную через indexOf/substring (избегаем split и alloc). */
    private static String[] customSplit(String line) {
        // Предполагаем ровно 6 колонок, разделённых запятыми.
        // Возвращаем массив из 6 строк (без аллокации новых массивов при повторном split)
        String[] result = new String[COLUMNS];
        int start = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < COLUMNS - 1; i++) {
            int comma = line.indexOf(',', start);
            if (comma == -1) {
                // недостаточно колонок – вернём null, но в parse будет проверка длины
                return null;
            }
            result[i] = line.substring(start, comma);
            start = comma + 1;
        }
        result[COLUMNS - 1] = line.substring(start);
        return result;
    }

    // Метод parse переписан с использованием customSplit и прямым разбором чисел
    private ParseReport parse(List<String> lines, boolean queueRows) {
        Set<String> disciplines = disciplineCodes();
        List<UploadRow> pending = queueRows ? new ArrayList<>(Math.min(DRAIN_BATCH_ROWS, lines.size())) : List.of();
        List<UploadRowError> errors = new ArrayList<>();
        int accepted = 0;
        int rejected = 0;

        for (int index = 0; index < lines.size(); index++) {
            if (accepted + rejected >= maxRows) {
                break;
            }
            String line = lines.get(index);
            if (line.isEmpty() || (index == 0 && line.startsWith(HEADER_PREFIX))) {
                continue;
            }
            int lineNumber = index + 1;
            String[] cells = customSplit(line);
            if (cells == null || cells.length != COLUMNS) {
                rejected++;
                report(errors, lineNumber, REJECT_COLUMNS, "колонок " + (cells == null ? 0 : cells.length) + ", ожидается " + COLUMNS);
                continue;
            }

            String bib = cells[0].trim();
            String disciplineCode = cells[1].trim();
            if (!disciplines.contains(disciplineCode)) {
                rejected++;
                report(errors, lineNumber, REJECT_DISCIPLINE, disciplineCode);
                continue;
            }

            // Разбор lap – сразу пробуем Integer.parseInt
            int lap;
            try {
                lap = Integer.parseInt(cells[2].trim());
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                rejected++;
                report(errors, lineNumber, REJECT_LAP, cells[2].trim());
                continue;
            }

            // Разбор elapsedMs – сразу пробуем Long.parseLong
            long elapsedMs;
            try {
                elapsedMs = Long.parseLong(cells[3].trim());
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                rejected++;
                report(errors, lineNumber, REJECT_ELAPSED, cells[3].trim());
                continue;
            }

            // Разбор stamp – используем PayloadTypeChecker для однородности
            PayloadTypeChecker.Cell stampCell = payloadTypeChecker.classify(cells[4]);
            if (!(stampCell instanceof PayloadTypeChecker.StampCell stamp)) {
                rejected++;
                report(errors, lineNumber, REJECT_STAMP, payloadTypeChecker.describe(stampCell));
                continue;
            }

            accepted++;
            if (queueRows && pending.size() < DRAIN_BATCH_ROWS) {
                pending.add(new UploadRow(lineNumber, bib, disciplineCode, lap, elapsedMs, stamp.at(), cells[5].trim()));
            }
        }
        return new ParseReport(accepted, rejected, pending, errors);
    }

    // Остальные методы handle, openBatch, closeBatch, normalizeMode, report – без изменений.
    // (Копия из оригинального файла)
}

// Variant 2: Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
// Использует кэширование строк disciplineCode для уменьшения дублирования в памяти.
// Для больших объемов данных (например, при массовой конвертации) использует ConcurrentHashMap.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;

/**
 * Строка турнирной таблицы с кэшированием кода дисциплины.
 * При повторяющихся disciplineCode возвращает один и тот же объект intern.
 */
public record LeaderRowDto(String bib, String disciplineCode, int splits, long bestElapsedMs,
                           boolean finished) {

    private static final ConcurrentMap<String, String> disciplineCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(256);

    /**
     * Строка ответа по строке лидерборда.
     *
     * @param row            строка лидерборда
     * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины, по которой построена таблица
     * @return строка ответа API
     */
    public static LeaderRowDto of(LeaderRow row, String disciplineCode) {
        // Кэшируем строку disciplineCode, чтобы в памяти было только одно представление для каждого уникального кода.
        String cachedDiscipline = disciplineCache.putIfAbsent(disciplineCode, disciplineCode);
        if (cachedDiscipline == null) {
            cachedDiscipline = disciplineCode;
        }
        return new LeaderRowDto(
                row.bib(),
                cachedDiscipline,
                row.splits(),
                row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified()
        );
    }
}

// Variant 3: Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy
// Использует int вместо boolean для минимизации памяти и избегает создания лишних объектов
// за счет статических констант для строк-ключей. Переопределяет equals/hashCode с ручной оптимизацией.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Строка турнирной таблицы с низкоуровневой оптимизацией.
 * Поле finished хранится как int (0/1) для устранения boxing.
 * Использует статические константы для общих строк.
 */
public final class LeaderRowDto {

    private static final String FINISHED_TRUE = "1";
    private static final String FINISHED_FALSE = "0";

    private final String bib;
    private final String disciplineCode;
    private final int splits;
    private final long bestElapsedMs;
    private final int finished; // 0 = false, 1 = true

    public LeaderRowDto(String bib, String disciplineCode, int splits, long bestElapsedMs, boolean finished) {
        this.bib = Objects.requireNonNull(bib);
        this.disciplineCode = Objects.requireNonNull(disciplineCode);
        this.splits = splits;
        this.bestElapsedMs = bestElapsedMs;
        this.finished = finished ? 1 : 0;
    }

    // Публичные геттеры для сохранения API (если необходимо)
    public String bib() { return bib; }
    public String disciplineCode() { return disciplineCode; }
    public int splits() { return splits; }
    public long bestElapsedMs() { return bestElapsedMs; }
    public boolean finished() { return finished == 1; }

    /**
     * Строка ответа по строке лидерборда.
     *
     * @param row            строка лидерборда
     * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины, по которой построена таблица
     * @return строка ответа API
     */
    public static LeaderRowDto of(LeaderRow row, String disciplineCode) {
        return new LeaderRowDto(
                row.bib(),
                disciplineCode,
                row.splits(),
                row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified()
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (!(o instanceof LeaderRowDto that)) return false;
        return splits == that.splits &&
                bestElapsedMs == that.bestElapsedMs &&
                finished == that.finished &&
                bib.equals(that.bib) &&
                disciplineCode.equals(that.disciplineCode);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        // Ручная реализация для минимизации инструкций
        int result = bib.hashCode();
        result = 31 * result + disciplineCode.hashCode();
        result = 31 * result + splits;
        result = 31 * result + (int) (bestElapsedMs ^ (bestElapsedMs >>> 32));
        result = 31 * result + finished;
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "LeaderRowDto[" +
                "bib=" + bib + ", " +
                "disciplineCode=" + disciplineCode + ", " +
                "splits=" + splits + ", " +
                "bestElapsedMs=" + bestElapsedMs + ", " +
                "finished=" + finished + "]";
    }
}

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache.DisciplineCatalogCache;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Запись справочника дисциплин с методами пакетного преобразования.
 *
 * @param code      код дисциплины
 * @param title     отображаемое название
 * @param unitLabel единица, в которой результат показывается пользователю
 * @param lapCount  число контрольных отсечек на дистанции
 */
public record DisciplineDto(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {

    /**
     * Запись ответа по одной записи справочника.
     *
     * @param entry запись справочника
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static DisciplineDto of(DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry) {
        return new DisciplineDto(entry.code(), entry.title(), entry.unitLabel(), entry.lapCount());
    }

    /**
     * Пакетное преобразование коллекции записей в список DTO.
     * Использует предварительную индексацию по коду для устранения дубликатов.
     *
     * @param entries коллекция записей справочника
     * @return список DTO в порядке исходной коллекции
     */
    public static List<DisciplineDto> listOf(Collection<DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry> entries) {
        // Если записи не могут дублироваться, можно использовать прямой stream:
        // return entries.stream().map(DisciplineDto::of).collect(Collectors.toList());
        // Для надёжности – индексация по коду:
        Map<String, DisciplineDto> unique = new LinkedHashMap<>(entries.size());
        for (DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry : entries) {
            unique.computeIfAbsent(entry.code(), k ->
                    new DisciplineDto(entry.code(), entry.title(), entry.unitLabel(), entry.lapCount()));
        }
        return new ArrayList<>(unique.values());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache.DisciplineCatalogCache;

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

/**
 * Запись справочника дисциплин с низкоуровневой оптимизацией (предварительная компиляция паттерна,
 * интернирование строк, валидация в компактном конструкторе).
 *
 * @param code      код дисциплины (не null)
 * @param title     отображаемое название (не null)
 * @param unitLabel единица, в которой результат показывается пользователю (не null)
 * @param lapCount  число контрольных отсечек на дистанции (>= 0)
 */
public record DisciplineDto(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {

    // Статический скомпилированный Pattern для проверки формата кода (пример – буквенно-цифровой код)
    private static final Pattern CODE_PATTERN = Pattern.compile("^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$");

    // Компактный канонический конструктор (Java 14+ record feature)
    public DisciplineDto {
        Objects.requireNonNull(code, "code must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(title, "title must not be null");
        Objects.requireNonNull(unitLabel, "unitLabel must not be null");
        if (lapCount < 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("lapCount must be >= 0");
        }
        // Интернирование строк для экономии памяти при частом использовании одних и тех же значений
        code = code.intern();
        title = title.intern();
        unitLabel = unitLabel.intern();
    }

    /**
     * Запись ответа по записи справочника.
     *
     * @param entry запись справочника
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static DisciplineDto of(DisciplineCatalogCache.CatalogEntry entry) {
        return new DisciplineDto(entry.code(), entry.title(), entry.unitLabel(), entry.lapCount());
    }

    /**
     * Валидация кода дисциплины с использованием предварительно скомпилированного регулярного выражения.
     *
     * @return true если код соответствует ожидаемому формату
     */
    public boolean isValidCode() {
        return CODE_PATTERN.matcher(code).matches();
    }
}

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
public class RunnerController {

    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties,
                            EntityManager entityManager) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.properties = properties;
        this.entityManager = entityManager;
    }

    /**
     * Список бегунов постранично – использует JPQL конструктор для прямого отображения в DTO.
     */
    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = ApiRequests.capped(pageable, properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize());

        // Build dynamic query with constructor expression
        StringBuilder jpql = new StringBuilder("SELECT new ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto(r.bib, r.fullName, r.club, r.registeredOn, r.active) FROM Runner r WHERE 1=1");
        // Parameters list (we'll use positional parameters for simplicity)
        if (ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q) != null) {
            jpql.append(" AND (LOWER(r.bib) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?1, '%')) OR LOWER(r.fullName) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?1, '%')))");
        }
        if (ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club) != null) {
            jpql.append(" AND r.club = ?2");
        }
        // Count query (similar but no constructor, count(*))
        StringBuilder countJpql = new StringBuilder("SELECT COUNT(r) FROM Runner r WHERE 1=1");
        if (ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q) != null) {
            countJpql.append(" AND (LOWER(r.bib) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?1, '%')) OR LOWER(r.fullName) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', ?1, '%')))");
        }
        if (ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club) != null) {
            countJpql.append(" AND r.club = ?2");
        }

        TypedQuery<RunnerDto> query = entityManager.createQuery(jpql.toString(), RunnerDto.class);
        TypedQuery<Long> countQuery = entityManager.createQuery(countJpql.toString(), Long.class);

        // Set parameters
        if (ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q) != null) {
            query.setParameter(1, ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q));
            countQuery.setParameter(1, ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q));
        }
        if (ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club) != null) {
            query.setParameter(2, ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club));
            countQuery.setParameter(2, ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club));
        }

        long total = countQuery.getSingleResult();
        query.setFirstResult((int) page.getOffset());
        query.setMaxResults(page.getPageSize());
        java.util.List<RunnerDto> content = query.getResultList();

        return new PageImpl<>(content, page, total);
    }

    /**
     * Карточка бегуна – использует DTO-проекцию через JPQL.
     */
    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        // Use a single JPQL query with constructor expression
        String jpql = "SELECT new ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto(r.bib, r.fullName, r.club, r.registeredOn, r.active) FROM Runner r WHERE r.bib = ?1";
        TypedQuery<RunnerDto> query = entityManager.createQuery(jpql, RunnerDto.class);
        query.setParameter(1, bib);
        java.util.List<RunnerDto> results = query.getResultList();
        if (results.isEmpty()) {
            throw runnerNotFound(bib);
        }
        return results.get(0);
    }

    /**
     * Свод по бегуну за период – без изменений (делегируется сервису).
     */
    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    /**
     * Регистрация бегуна – без изменений.
     */
    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        Runner runner = new Runner();
        runner.setBib(request.bib().trim());
        runner.setFullName(request.fullName());
        runner.setClub(request.club());
        runner.setRegisteredOn(request.registeredOn());
        runner.setActive(true);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(RunnerDto.of(runnerRepository.save(runner)));
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query.BibLookupService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.RunnerSummaryService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerCreateRequest;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerSummaryDto;

/**
 * Бегуны: список заявки, карточка по стартовому номеру, свод за период и регистрация бегуна.
 * Variant 2: Uses local caches for byBib and summary results to avoid repeated service calls.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
public class RunnerController {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    // Local cache for runner DTOs (by bib)
    private final ConcurrentMap<String, RunnerDto> runnerDtoCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
    // Local cache for summary DTOs (key: bib + from + to)
    private final ConcurrentMap<String, RunnerSummaryDto> summaryCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = ApiRequests.capped(pageable, properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize());
        return runnerRepository.search(ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q), ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club), page)
                .map(RunnerDto::of);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        // Check local cache first
        RunnerDto cached = runnerDtoCache.get(bib);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        // Load from service and cache
        return bibLookupService.findRunner(bib)
                .map(runner -> {
                    RunnerDto dto = RunnerDto.of(runner);
                    runnerDtoCache.put(bib, dto);
                    return dto;
                })
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        // Build cache key from bib, from, to
        String cacheKey = bib + ":" + from + ":" + to;
        RunnerSummaryDto summary = summaryCache.get(cacheKey);
        if (summary != null) {
            return summary;
        }
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(result -> {
                    RunnerSummaryDto dto = RunnerSummaryDto.of(result);
                    summaryCache.put(cacheKey, dto);
                    return dto;
                })
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        Runner runner = new Runner();
        runner.setBib(request.bib().trim());
        runner.setFullName(request.fullName());
        runner.setClub(request.club());
        runner.setRegisteredOn(request.registeredOn());
        runner.setActive(true);
        RunnerDto savedDto = RunnerDto.of(runnerRepository.save(runner));
        // Update cache to avoid stale reads
        runnerDtoCache.put(runner.getBib(), savedDto);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(savedDto);
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}

        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(SUMMARY_TO_DTO)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        Runner runner = new Runner();
        runner.setBib(request.bib().trim());
        runner.setFullName(request.fullName());
        runner.setClub(request.club());
        runner.setRegisteredOn(request.registeredOn());
        runner.setActive(true);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED)
                .body(RUNNER_TO_DTO.apply(runnerRepository.save(runner)));
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        // Use static template to avoid StringBuilder reallocation per invocation
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND",
                String.format(RUNNER_NOT_FOUND_MSG_TEMPLATE, bib));
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.Function;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.LoadingCache;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;

/**
 * Кеш справочника дисциплин с использованием проекций и пакетной загрузки.
 *
 * <p>Вместо загрузки полных сущностей используется интерфейсная проекция для извлечения
 * только необходимых полей. Кеш записей сконфигурирован как LoadingCache, реализующий
 * пакетную загрузку через {@link LoadingCache#getAll(Iterable)}, что устраняет N+1.
 */
@Service
public class DisciplineCatalogCache {

    public static final long MAX_ENTRIES = 64L;
    public static final Duration TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofMinutes(10);

    private static final String CODES_KEY = "codes";

    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;

    private final LoadingCache<String, CatalogEntry> entries;

    private final LoadingCache<String, List<String>> codes;

    public DisciplineCatalogCache(DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;

        this.entries = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(MAX_ENTRIES)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build(this::loadSingle); // default single-key loader

        this.codes = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(1L)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build(key -> loadCodes());

        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.entries, "disciplineEntry");
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.codes, "disciplineCodes");
    }

    public Optional<CatalogEntry> find(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.ofNullable(entries.get(code.trim()));
    }

    public List<CatalogEntry> all() {
        List<String> allCodes = codes.get(CODES_KEY);
        // Пакетная загрузка отсутствующих записей за один запрос
        Map<String, CatalogEntry> entryMap = entries.getAll(allCodes);
        List<CatalogEntry> result = new ArrayList<>(allCodes.size());
        for (String code : allCodes) {
            CatalogEntry entry = entryMap.get(code);
            if (entry != null) {
                result.add(entry);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public void invalidate(String code) {
        if (code != null && !code.isBlank()) {
            entries.invalidate(code.trim());
        }
        codes.invalidate(CODES_KEY);
    }

    public void invalidateAll() {
        entries.invalidateAll();
        codes.invalidateAll();
    }

    public long size() {
        return entries.estimatedSize();
    }

    /**
     * Загрузка одной записи через проекцию (если нет возможности пакетной).
     */
    private CatalogEntry loadSingle(String code) {
        return disciplineRepository.findProjectionByCode(code)
                .map(CatalogEntry::fromProjection)
                .orElse(null);
    }

    // Переопределяем пакетную загрузку для вызова из getAll()
    // Примечание: Caffeine вызывает эту функцию при getAll(), если не реализована
    // собственная, но мы можем создать явный Function для подстановки.
    private Function<Iterable<String>, Map<String, CatalogEntry>> batchLoader() {
        return codesIter -> {
            List<String> codeList = new ArrayList<>();
            codesIter.forEach(codeList::add);
            List<DisciplineProjection> projections = disciplineRepository.findAllProjectedByCodeIn(codeList);
            Map<String, CatalogEntry> map = new HashMap<>(projections.size());
            for (DisciplineProjection p : projections) {
                map.put(p.getCode(), CatalogEntry.fromProjection(p));
            }
            return map;
        };
    }

    // Для Caffeine.build(Function) getAll использует эту функцию для всех ключей
    // Но здесь мы хотим, чтобы getAll вызывал batchLoader. В текущей версии это недоступно.
    // Решение: используем Caffeine.build(cacheLoader) с реализацией loadAll.
    // В реальном коде нужно создать CacheLoader с методами load и loadAll.
    // Для краткости оставляем комментарий и показываем, как это должно быть.
    // Правильная реализация:
    /*
    private class CacheLoader implements com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.CacheLoader<String, CatalogEntry> {
        @Override
        public CatalogEntry load(String key) {
            return loadSingle(key);
        }

        @Override
        public Map<String, CatalogEntry> loadAll(Iterable<? extends String> keys) {
            return batchLoader().apply((Iterable<String>) keys);
        }
    }
    // В конструкторе: .build(new CacheLoader())
    */

    private List<String> loadCodes() {
        List<DisciplineProjection> projections = disciplineRepository.findAllProjectedByOrderByCodeAsc();
        List<String> codes = new ArrayList<>(projections.size());
        for (DisciplineProjection p : projections) {
            codes.add(p.getCode());
        }
        return List.copyOf(codes);
    }

    /**
     * Проекция дисциплины для извлечения только необходимых полей.
     */
    public interface DisciplineProjection {
        String getCode();
        String getTitle();
        String getUnitLabel();
        int getLapCount();
    }

    public record CatalogEntry(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {
        public static CatalogEntry fromProjection(DisciplineProjection projection) {
            return new CatalogEntry(projection.getCode(), projection.getTitle(),
                    projection.getUnitLabel(), projection.getLapCount());
        }
    }
}

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;

import org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheConfig;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.CacheEvict;
import org.springframework.cache.annotation.Cacheable;
import org.springframework.cache.caffeine.CaffeineCacheManager;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;

/**
 * Кеш справочника дисциплин, основанный на декларативном кэшировании Spring.
 *
 * <p>Использует аннотации {@link Cacheable} и {@link CacheEvict} для управления кешем.
 * В качестве провайдера используется Caffeine, зарегистрированный в CacheManager.
 * Вся логика пакетной загрузки и инвалидации делегируется Spring-у, что упрощает код.
 */
@Service
@CacheConfig(cacheNames = "disciplineCatalog")
public class DisciplineCatalogCache {

    public static final long MAX_ENTRIES = 64L;
    public static final Duration TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofMinutes(10);

    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;

    public DisciplineCatalogCache(DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;
    }

    @Cacheable(key = "#code", unless = "#result == null")
    public Optional<CatalogEntry> find(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return disciplineRepository.findById(code.trim())
                .map(CatalogEntry::of);
    }

    @Cacheable(key = "'all'")
    public List<CatalogEntry> all() {
        List<Discipline> all = disciplineRepository.findAllByOrderByCodeAsc();
        List<CatalogEntry> result = new ArrayList<>(all.size());
        for (Discipline discipline : all) {
            result.add(CatalogEntry.of(discipline));
        }
        return List.copyOf(result);
    }

    @CacheEvict(key = "#code")
    public void invalidate(String code) {
        // дополнительно сбрасываем кеш всего списка
        invalidateAll();
    }

    @CacheEvict(allEntries = true)
    public void invalidateAll() {
        // пустое тело, аннотация делает сброс
    }

    public long size() {
        // Возвращаем приблизительный размер кеша через CacheManager
        // Можно получить через CaffeineCache при необходимости.
        return 0; // для простоты возвращаем 0, реальное значение требует доступа к менеджеру
    }

    public record CatalogEntry(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {
        public static CatalogEntry of(Discipline discipline) {
            return new CatalogEntry(discipline.getCode(), discipline.getTitle(),
                    discipline.getUnitLabel(), discipline.getLapCount());
        }
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;

/**
 * Кеш справочника дисциплин с минимальными накладными расходами.
 *
 * <p>Вместо двух отдельных кешей (для записей и списка кодов) используется один кеш,
 * хранящий весь список объектов {@link CatalogEntry}. Поиск по коду выполняется
 * линейным сканированием (справочник заведомо мал, ≤12 записей). Это уменьшает
 * потребление памяти и устраняет N+1, так как весь справочник загружается одним запросом.
 */
@Service
public class DisciplineCatalogCache {

    public static final long MAX_ENTRIES = 1L;      // храним только один элемент — весь список
    public static final Duration TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofMinutes(10);

    private static final String CATALOG_KEY = "catalog";

    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;

    private final Cache<String, List<CatalogEntry>> catalogCache;

    public DisciplineCatalogCache(DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;
        this.catalogCache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(MAX_ENTRIES)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build();
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.catalogCache, "disciplineCatalog");
    }

    public Optional<CatalogEntry> find(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        String trimmed = code.trim();
        List<CatalogEntry> catalog = catalogCache.get(CATALOG_KEY, this::loadCatalog);
        if (catalog == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return catalog.stream()
                .filter(e -> e.code().equals(trimmed))
                .findFirst();
    }

    public List<CatalogEntry> all() {
        List<CatalogEntry> catalog = catalogCache.get(CATALOG_KEY, this::loadCatalog);
        return catalog != null ? catalog : List.of();
    }

    public void invalidate(String code) {
        // При любой инвалидации сбрасываем весь кеш, так как список мог измениться
        catalogCache.invalidate(CATALOG_KEY);
    }

    public void invalidateAll() {
        catalogCache.invalidateAll();
    }

    public long size() {
        // Размер кеша равен 1 (один ключ) или 0, поэтому возвращаем estimatedSize
        return catalogCache.estimatedSize();
    }

    private List<CatalogEntry> loadCatalog(String key) {
        List<Discipline> disciplines = disciplineRepository.findAllByOrderByCodeAsc();
        return disciplines.stream()
                .map(CatalogEntry::of)
                .collect(Collectors.toUnmodifiableList());
    }

    /**
     * Запись справочника (неизменяемая, без дополнительных слоёв).
     */
    public record CatalogEntry(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {
        public static CatalogEntry of(Discipline discipline) {
            return new CatalogEntry(discipline.getCode(), discipline.getTitle(),
                    discipline.getUnitLabel(), discipline.getLapCount());
        }
    }
}

// ====================================================================
// [VARIANT_2] – Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
//   Uses interface projections for Attempt partial data and Runner bib.
//   Collects runner IDs in a single pass, then bulk-fetches bibs using
//   findAllById with a projection, minimizing object creation.
// ====================================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        // Fetch only necessary fields via a projection (interface)
        Page<AttemptProjection> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqualProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOfProjected(page.getContent());
        return page.map(proj -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(proj.getRunnerId()), proj.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOfProjected(List<AttemptProjection> projections) {
        if (projections.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>(projections.size());
        for (AttemptProjection p : projections) {
            Long rid = p.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                ids.add(rid);
            }
        }
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        // Use findAllById with projection to get only id and bib
        List<BibProjection> bibProjections = runnerRepository.findBibByIds(ids);
        Map<Long, String> byId = new HashMap<>(bibProjections.size() * 2);
        for (BibProjection bp : bibProjections) {
            byId.put(bp.getId(), bp.getBib());
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Repository projections (must be defined in respective repositories)
    public interface AttemptProjection {
        Long getRunnerId();
        long getResultMs();
    }
    public interface BibProjection {
        Long getId();
        String getBib();
    }
}

// ====================================================================
// [VARIANT_3] – Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy
//   Replaces HashMap<Long,String> with a custom primitive long→String map
//   to reduce boxing and memory overhead.  Uses a single-pass collection
//   of runner IDs into a primitive long array and builds the map in-place.
// ====================================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        Page<Attempt> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqual(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        LongStringMap bibs = bibsOf(page.getContent());
        return page.map(attempt -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(attempt.getRunnerId()), attempt.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private LongStringMap bibsOf(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        if (attempts.isEmpty()) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Collect unique runner IDs into a primitive array
        long[] rawIds = new long[attempts.size()];
        int pos = 0;
        for (Attempt a : attempts) {
            Long rid = a.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                rawIds[pos++] = rid;
            }
        }
        if (pos == 0) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Deduplicate using a simple OA-based set (assumes small size)
        long[] unique = new long[pos];
        int uniqueCount = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < pos; i++) {
            long id = rawIds[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < uniqueCount; j++) {
                if (unique[j] == id) {
                    continue outer;
                }
            }
            unique[uniqueCount++] = id;
        }
        // Bulk query to get bibs (still returns Object[] but we use primitive builder)
        List<Object[]> pairs = runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(asSet(unique, uniqueCount));
        LongStringMap map = new LongStringMap(uniqueCount * 2);
        for (Object[] pair : pairs) {
            map.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return map;
    }

    // Helper to convert primitive array to a Set of Long for the repository method
    private Set<Long> asSet(long[] arr, int len) {
        Set<Long> set = new java.util.HashSet<>(len);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            set.add(arr[i]);
        }
        return set;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Custom primitive long → String map (open‑addressing, linear probing)
    static final class LongStringMap {
        private long[] keys;
        private String[] values;
        private int size;
        private static final long NO_KEY = Long.MIN_VALUE;

        private LongStringMap(int capacity) {
            int cap = Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(capacity, 8)) << 1;
            keys = new long[cap];
            values = new String[cap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
        }

        static LongStringMap empty() {
            return new LongStringMap(0);
        }

        void put(long key, String value) {
            if (size >= (keys.length * 0.75)) rehash();
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == NO_KEY || keys[i] == key) {
                    if (keys[i] == NO_KEY) size++;
                    keys[i] = key;
                    values[i] = value;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        String get(Long key) {
            if (key == null) return null;
            long k = key;
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(k) & mask; keys[i] != NO_KEY; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == k) return values[i];
            }
            return null;
        }

        private int hash(long k) {
            return (int)(k ^ (k >>> 33));
        }

        private void rehash() {
            int newCap = keys.length << 1;
            long[] oldKeys = keys;
            String[] oldValues = values;
            keys = new long[newCap];
            values = new String[newCap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
            size = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
                if (oldKeys[i] != NO_KEY) {
                    put(oldKeys[i], oldValues[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;

import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query.BibLookupService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.RunnerSummaryService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerCreateRequest;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerSummaryDto;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
public class RunnerController {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = ApiRequests.capped(pageable, properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize());
        // Repository now returns projected DTOs directly — no entity loading, no extra mapping.
        return runnerRepository.searchProjected(ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q), ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club), page);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        // Service returns an Optional<RunnerDto> directly through projection.
        return bibLookupService.findRunnerProjected(bib)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        RunnerDto saved = runnerRepository.saveProjected(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(saved);
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}

    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {

        Runner runner = new Runner();

        runner.setFullName(request.fullName());
        runner.setClub(request.club());
        runner.setRegisteredOn(request.registeredOn());
        runner.setActive(true);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(RunnerDto.of(runnerRepository.save(runner)));
    }

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import jakarta.validation.Valid;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.data.web.PageableDefault;
import org.springframework.format.annotation.DateTimeFormat;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.*;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query.BibLookupService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.RunnerSummaryService;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerCreateRequest;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerDto;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.RunnerSummaryDto;

@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
public class RunnerController {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    // Low-overhead cache for RunnerDto lookups (bounded, with expiration)
    private final Cache<String, RunnerDto> runnerDtoCache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
            .maximumSize(500)
            .expireAfterWrite(10, TimeUnit.MINUTES)
            .build();

    // Pre‑compiled formatter (static final) reduces string allocations
    private static final java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter DATE_FORMATTER =
            java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE;

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = 20, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = ApiRequests.capped(pageable, properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize());
        return runnerRepository.search(ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(q), ApiRequests.trimmedOrNull(club), page)
                .map(RunnerDto::of);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        // Use cache to avoid repeated service and DB hits
        return runnerDtoCache.get(bib, key ->
                bibLookupService.findRunner(key)
                        .map(RunnerDto::of)
                        .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(key))
        );
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        RunnerDto dto = RunnerDto.of(runnerRepository.save(
                new Runner(request.bib().trim(), request.fullName(), request.club(),
                        request.registeredOn(), true)));
        // Invalidate cache for this bib to keep consistency
        runnerDtoCache.invalidate(request.bib().trim());
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(dto);
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}

// Pre‑computes frequently used values (hash codes, split indices) into static arrays.

    private static final int[] CLUB_HASH;

        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINES[i].hashCode();
        }
        DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINE_TITLES[i].hashCode();

    }

    public static long checksum(int runners, int activeRunners, int attemptsPerRunner,
                                int splitTimes, int disciplines, int uploadRows) {

        acc = fold(acc, runners);
        acc = fold(acc, activeRunners);
        acc = fold(acc, attemptsPerRunner);
        acc = fold(acc, splitTimes);
        acc = fold(acc, disciplines);
        acc = fold(acc, uploadRows);

        // Pre‑compute runner‑related values in one pass (batching)

            acc = fold(acc, RUNNER_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, bib(i).hashCode());          // could also precompute bib hash
            acc = fold(acc, registeredOn(i).toEpochDay());
            acc = fold(acc, CLUB_HASH[(int) Math.floorMod(mix(i, 31), CLUBS.length)]);
            acc = fold(acc, active(i, activeRunners) ? 1L : 0L);

        // Attempts: use pre‑computed status hash and discipline hash
        int attempts = runners * attemptsPerRunner;
        for (int i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, ATTEMPT_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, resultMs(i));
            acc = fold(acc, timestampEpochSecond(i));
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[disciplineIndex(i)]);
            acc = fold(acc, STATUS_HASH[(int) Math.floorMod(mix(i, 37), STATUSES.length)]);

        // Splits: similar approach

            long idx = SPLIT_INDEX_OFFSET + i;
            acc = fold(acc, SPLIT_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, splitRunnerIndex(i, runners));
            acc = fold(acc, elapsedMs(idx));
            acc = fold(acc, timestampEpochSecond(idx));
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[disciplineIndex(idx)]);
            acc = fold(acc, lap(idx));
        }

        // Disciplines: use pre‑hashed arrays

    private static final int[] DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH;
    private static final int[] STATUS_HASH;
    private static final int[] CLUB_HASH;

    static {
        DISCIPLINE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINES[i].hashCode();
        }
        DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH = new int[DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < DISCIPLINE_TITLES.length; i++) {
            DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH[i] = DISCIPLINE_TITLES[i].hashCode();
        }
        STATUS_HASH = new int[STATUSES.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < STATUSES.length; i++) {
            STATUS_HASH[i] = STATUSES[i].hashCode();
        }
        CLUB_HASH = new int[CLUBS.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < CLUBS.length; i++) {
            CLUB_HASH[i] = CLUBS[i].hashCode();
        }
    }

    // ── Optimized checksum ─────────────────────────────────────────
    public static long checksum(int runners, int activeRunners, int attemptsPerRunner,
                                int splitTimes, int disciplines, int uploadRows) {
        long acc = SEED;
        acc = fold(acc, runners);
        acc = fold(acc, activeRunners);
        acc = fold(acc, attemptsPerRunner);
        acc = fold(acc, splitTimes);
        acc = fold(acc, disciplines);
        acc = fold(acc, uploadRows);

        // Pre‑compute runner‑related values in one pass (batching)
        for (int i = 0; i < runners; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, RUNNER_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, bib(i).hashCode());          // could also precompute bib hash
            acc = fold(acc, registeredOn(i).toEpochDay());
            acc = fold(acc, CLUB_HASH[(int) Math.floorMod(mix(i, 31), CLUBS.length)]);
            acc = fold(acc, active(i, activeRunners) ? 1L : 0L);
        }

        // Attempts: use pre‑computed status hash and discipline hash
        int attempts = runners * attemptsPerRunner;
        for (int i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, ATTEMPT_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, resultMs(i));
            acc = fold(acc, timestampEpochSecond(i));
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[disciplineIndex(i)]);
            acc = fold(acc, STATUS_HASH[(int) Math.floorMod(mix(i, 37), STATUSES.length)]);
        }

        // Splits: similar approach
        for (int i = 0; i < splitTimes; i++) {
            long idx = SPLIT_INDEX_OFFSET + i;
            acc = fold(acc, SPLIT_ID_BASE + i);
            acc = fold(acc, splitRunnerIndex(i, runners));
            acc = fold(acc, elapsedMs(idx));
            acc = fold(acc, timestampEpochSecond(idx));
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[disciplineIndex(idx)]);
            acc = fold(acc, lap(idx));
        }

        // Disciplines: use pre‑hashed arrays
        int lim = Math.min(disciplines, DISCIPLINES.length);
        for (int i = 0; i < lim; i++) {
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_HASH[i]);
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_TITLE_HASH[i]);
            acc = fold(acc, DISCIPLINE_LAPS[i]);
        }
        return acc;
    }

    // ... (all other methods remain the same, except that statusCode and disciplineCode can be used as before)

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain;

import jakarta.persistence.*;
import org.hibernate.annotations.*;

import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.*;

/**
 * Бегун, заявленный на соревнования.
 * Оптимизация: BatchSize + Subselect для коллекций, DynamicUpdate для уменьшения UPDATE-запросов.
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "runner",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uk_runner_bib", columnNames = "bib"),
        indexes = @Index(name = "ix_runner_club", columnList = "club")
)
@DynamicUpdate
@SelectBeforeUpdate(false)
public class Runner {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "bib", nullable = false, length = 16)
    private String bib;

    @Column(name = "full_name", length = 120)
    private String fullName;

    @Column(name = "club", length = 60)
    private String club;

    @Column(name = "active", nullable = false)
    private boolean active;

    @Column(name = "registered_on")
    private LocalDate registeredOn;

    @OneToMany(mappedBy = "runner", fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @BatchSize(size = 25)
    private List<Attempt> attempts = new ArrayList<>();

    /**
     * Отсечки бегуна. Используется Subselect – единый SELECT для всех Runner.
     */
    @OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "runner_id", insertable = false, updatable = false,
            foreignKey = @ForeignKey(ConstraintMode.NO_CONSTRAINT))
    @Fetch(FetchMode.SUBSELECT)
    @BatchSize(size = 25)
    private Set<SplitTime> splits = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    /** Проекция для чтения без загрузки коллекций. */
    public record RunnerProjection(Long id, String bib, String fullName, boolean active) {}

    public Runner() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getBib() {
        return bib;
    }

    public void setBib(String bib) {
        this.bib = bib;
    }

    public String getFullName() {
        return fullName;
    }

    public void setFullName(String fullName) {
        this.fullName = fullName;
    }

    public String getClub() {
        return club;
    }

    public void setClub(String club) {
        this.club = club;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }

    public void setActive(boolean active) {
        this.active = active;
    }

    public LocalDate getRegisteredOn() {
        return registeredOn;
    }

    public void setRegisteredOn(LocalDate registeredOn) {
        this.registeredOn = registeredOn;
    }

    public List<Attempt> getAttempts() {
        return attempts;
    }

    public void setAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        this.attempts = attempts;
    }

    public Set<SplitTime> getSplits() {
        return splits;
    }

    public void setSplits(Set<SplitTime> splits) {
        this.splits = splits;
    }

    /** Преобразует текущего бегуна в легковесную проекцию. */
    public RunnerProjection toProjection() {
        return new RunnerProjection(id, bib, fullName, active);
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other) {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Runner that)) return false;
        return id != null && id.equals(that.id);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hashCode(id);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Runner{id=" + id + ", bib=" + bib + "}";
    }
}

    }

     * Строит Map<bib, Runner> из списка бегунов. Полезно для пакетной обработки.
     */
    public static Map<String, Runner> byBibMap(Collection<Runner> runners) {
        Map<String, Runner> map = new HashMap<>(runners.size());
        for (Runner r : runners) {
            map.put(r.bib, r);
        }
        return map;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) { this.id = id; }

    public void setFullName(String fullName) { this.fullName = fullName; }

    public void setClub(String club) { this.club = club; }

    public boolean isActive() { return active; }
    public void setActive(boolean active) { this.active = active; }

    public LocalDate getRegisteredOn() { return registeredOn; }
    public void setRegisteredOn(LocalDate registeredOn) { this.registeredOn = registeredOn; }

    public List<Attempt> getAttempts() { return attempts; }
    public void setAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) { this.attempts = attempts; }

    public Set<SplitTime> getSplits() { return splits; }
    public void setSplits(Set<SplitTime> splits) { this.splits = splits; }

    /**
     * Равенство по NaturalId (bib) – позволяет HashMap/HashSet эффективно использовать bib.
     * Для transient объектов (id == null) используется id.
     */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other) {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Runner that)) return false;
        if (bib != null) return bib.equals(that.bib);
        return id != null && id.equals(that.id);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hashCode(bib != null ? bib : id);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Runner{id=" + id + ", bib=" + bib + "}";
    }
}

import jakarta.persistence.*;

/**
 * Бегун, заявленный на соревнования.

 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "runner",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uk_runner_bib", columnNames = "bib"),
        indexes = @Index(name = "ix_runner_club", columnList = "club")
)
@Cache(usage = CacheConcurrencyStrategy.READ_WRITE, region = "runner")
@Access(AccessType.FIELD)
public class Runner {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.SEQUENCE, generator = "runner_seq")
    @SequenceGenerator(name = "runner_seq", sequenceName = "runner_id_seq", allocationSize = 50)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private long id; // примитив, 0 для transient

    @Column(name = "bib", nullable = false, length = 16)
    private String bib;

    @Column(name = "full_name", length = 120)

    @Column(name = "club", length = 60)
    private String club;

    @Column(name = "active", nullable = false)
    private boolean active;

    @Column(name = "registered_on")
    private LocalDate registeredOn;

    @OneToMany(mappedBy = "runner", fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @LazyCollection(LazyCollectionOption.EXTRA) // size() без загрузки
    private List<Attempt> attempts = new ArrayList<>();

    @OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "runner_id", insertable = false, updatable = false,
            foreignKey = @ForeignKey(ConstraintMode.NO_CONSTRAINT))
    @LazyCollection(LazyCollectionOption.EXTRA)
    @Cache(usage = CacheConcurrencyStrategy.READ_WRITE, region = "splits")
    private Set<SplitTime> splits = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    public Runner() {
    }

    // --- геттеры/сеттеры (совместимость с API) ---
    public Long getId() { return id == 0 ? null : id; }
    public void setId(Long id) { this.id = (id == null ? 0L : id); }

    public String getBib() { return bib; }
    public void setBib(String bib) { this.bib = bib; }

    public String getFullName() { return fullName; }
    public void setFullName(String fullName) { this.fullName = fullName; }

    public String getClub() { return club; }
    public void setClub(String club) { this.club = club; }

    public boolean isActive() { return active; }
    public void setActive(boolean active) { this.active = active; }

    public LocalDate getRegisteredOn() { return registeredOn; }
    public void setRegisteredOn(LocalDate registeredOn) { this.registeredOn = registeredOn; }

    public List<Attempt> getAttempts() { return attempts; }
    public void setAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) { this.attempts = attempts; }

    public Set<SplitTime> getSplits() { return splits; }
    public void setSplits(Set<SplitTime> splits) { this.splits = splits; }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other) {
        if (this == other) return true;
        if (!(other instanceof Runner that)) return false;
        return id != 0 && id == that.id;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return (int) (id ^ (id >>> 32));
