package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;

/**
 * Строка турнирной таблицы с кешированием созданных объектов (LRU).
 *
 * @param bib            стартовый номер бегуна
 * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины
 * @param splits         число отсечек бегуна, попавших в отчётное окно
 * @param bestElapsedMs  лучшее время прохождения в миллисекундах
 * @param finished       в окно попала хотя бы одна отсечка бегуна
 */
public record LeaderRowDto(String bib, String disciplineCode, int splits, long bestElapsedMs,
                           boolean finished) {

    private static final int MAX_CACHE_SIZE = 128;

    // Cache key: concatenation of row.bib() and disciplineCode (assume discipline codes are short)
    private static final Map<String, LeaderRowDto> cache = new LinkedHashMap<>(MAX_CACHE_SIZE, 0.75f, true) {
        @Override
        protected boolean removeEldestEntry(Map.Entry<String, LeaderRowDto> eldest) {
            return size() > MAX_CACHE_SIZE;
        }
    };

    /**
     * Строка ответа по строке лидерборда.
     *
     * @param row            строка лидерборда
     * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины, по которой построена таблица
     * @return строка ответа API (возможно, из кеша)
     */
    public static LeaderRowDto of(LeaderRow row, String disciplineCode) {
        String key = row.bib() + "::" + disciplineCode;
        LeaderRowDto cached = cache.get(key);
        if (cached != null) {
            return cached;
        }
        LeaderRowDto dto = new LeaderRowDto(row.bib(), disciplineCode, row.splits(), row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified());
        cache.put(key, dto);
        return dto;
    }
}

/**
 * Строка турнирной таблицы с переопределённым toString (без формирования строки при каждом вызове)

 * @param bib            стартовый номер бегуна

 * @param finished       в окно попала хотя бы одна отсечка бегуна
 */
public class LeaderRowDto implements Comparable<LeaderRowDto> {

    private final String bib;
    private final String disciplineCode;
    private final int splits;
    private final long bestElapsedMs;
    private final boolean finished;

    private final String toStringCache; // computed once in constructor

                "disciplineCode=" + disciplineCode + ", " +
                "splits=" + splits + ", " +
                "bestElapsedMs=" + bestElapsedMs + ", " +
                "finished=" + finished +
                "]";

    public String bib() { return bib; }
    public String disciplineCode() { return disciplineCode; }
    public int splits() { return splits; }
    public long bestElapsedMs() { return bestElapsedMs; }
    public boolean finished() { return finished; }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return toStringCache;
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return hashCode;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
        if (this == obj) return true;
        if (obj == null || getClass() != obj.getClass()) return false;
        LeaderRowDto other = (LeaderRowDto) obj;
        return splits == other.splits
                && bestElapsedMs == other.bestElapsedMs
                && finished == other.finished
                && bib.equals(other.bib)
                && disciplineCode.equals(other.disciplineCode);
    }

    @Override
    public int compareTo(LeaderRowDto other) {
        int cmp = bib.compareTo(other.bib);
        if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
        cmp = disciplineCode.compareTo(other.disciplineCode);
        if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
        cmp = Integer.compare(splits, other.splits);
        if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
        cmp = Long.compare(bestElapsedMs, other.bestElapsedMs);
        if (cmp != 0) return cmp;
        return Boolean.compare(finished, other.finished);
    }

    /**
     * Строка ответа по строке лидерборда.
     *
     * @param row            строка лидерборда
     * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины, по которой построена таблица
     * @return строка ответа API
     */
    public static LeaderRowDto of(LeaderRow row, String disciplineCode) {
        return new LeaderRowDto(
                row.bib(),
                disciplineCode,
                row.splits(),
                row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified()
        );
    }

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Collection;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;
import java.util.function.Function;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.RequestTrace;

/**
 * TraceDto with a batch‑oriented static factory that uses an upfront
 * in‑memory map to avoid repeated lookups and parallel stream for bulk conversion.
 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    // Lightweight cache for mapping traces that might be reused (optional, but fits the batching theme)
    private static final ConcurrentMap<String, String> ROUTE_CACHE = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(64);

    /**
     * Static factory from a single entity (kept for backward compatibility).
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(
                internIfNotNull(trace.getRoute()),
                trace.getVerb(),
                trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(),
                trace.getCapturedAt(),
                trace.getTraceId()
        );
    }

    /**
     * Converts a collection of RequestTrace entities into a list of TraceDto using
     * parallel stream and a shared cache for route strings to reduce memory pressure.
     *
     * @param traces input entities
     * @return list of DTOs
     */
    public static List<TraceDto> fromEntities(Collection<RequestTrace> traces) {
        return traces.parallelStream()
                .map(trace -> new TraceDto(
                        internIfNotNull(trace.getRoute()),
                        trace.getVerb(),
                        trace.getOutcome(),
                        trace.getDurationMs(),
                        trace.getCapturedAt(),
                        trace.getTraceId()
                ))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private static String internIfNotNull(String value) {
        if (value == null) return null;
        return ROUTE_CACHE.computeIfAbsent(value, Function.identity());
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import java.time.Instant;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.RequestTrace;

/**
 * TraceDto with low‑overhead optimizations:
 * <ul>
 *   <li>String interning for route, verb, and traceId to reduce duplicate strings</li>
 *   <li>Pre‑compiled constant for the zero‑allocation path (e.g. reused builder)</li>
 * </ul>
 * The public API (fields, method signatures) remains unchanged.
 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    // Pre‑compiled shared instance for the most common trace attributes (demonstration only)
    private static final String EMPTY_ROUTE = "";

    /**
     * Static factory that interns string fields to minimise memory footprint.
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(
                intern(trace.getRoute()),
                intern(trace.getVerb()),
                trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(),
                trace.getCapturedAt(),
                intern(trace.getTraceId())
        );
    }

    /**
     * Interns the given string, returning a canonical representation.
     * For empty/null strings the method avoids the interning cost.
     */
    private static String intern(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
            return EMPTY_ROUTE;  // single shared empty string
        }
        return value.intern();   // JVM‑wide deduplication
    }
}

    }

    public void setMedianResultMs(long medianResultMs) {
        this.medianResultMs = medianResultMs;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        // Использование StringBuilder и кешированного форматтера для уменьшения аллокаций
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder(80);
        sb.append("LeaderboardRow{id=").append(id)
          .append(", runnerId=").append(runnerId)
          .append(", heldOn=");

    }

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;

@Service
public class DisciplineCatalogCache {

    public static final long MAX_ENTRIES = 64L;
    public static final Duration TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofMinutes(10);
    private static final String CODES_KEY = "codes";

    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;
    private final Cache<String, CatalogEntry> entries;
    private final Cache<String, List<String>> codes;

    public DisciplineCatalogCache(DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;
        this.entries = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(MAX_ENTRIES)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build();
        this.codes = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(1L)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build();
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.entries, "disciplineEntry");
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.codes, "disciplineCodes");
    }

    public Optional<CatalogEntry> find(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.ofNullable(entries.get(code.trim(), this::loadSingle));
    }

    public List<CatalogEntry> all() {
        List<String> allCodes = codes.get(CODES_KEY, key -> loadCodes());
        // Load all entries at once using a projection query
        List<CatalogEntry> loaded = disciplineRepository.findAllProjectedByCodeIn(allCodes);
        // Put each loaded entry into the cache for future single lookups
        for (CatalogEntry entry : loaded) {
            entries.put(entry.code(), entry);
        }
        return loaded;
    }

    public void invalidate(String code) {
        if (code != null && !code.isBlank()) {
            entries.invalidate(code.trim());
        }
        codes.invalidate(CODES_KEY);
    }

    public void invalidateAll() {
        entries.invalidateAll();
        codes.invalidateAll();
    }

    public long size() {
        return entries.estimatedSize();
    }

    private CatalogEntry loadSingle(String code) {
        return disciplineRepository.findProjectedById(code).orElse(null);
    }

    private List<String> loadCodes() {
        List<String> codes = disciplineRepository.findAllCodesOrderByCodeAsc();
        return List.copyOf(codes);
    }

    public record CatalogEntry(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {
        public static CatalogEntry of(Discipline discipline) {
            return new CatalogEntry(discipline.getCode(), discipline.getTitle(),
                discipline.getUnitLabel(), discipline.getLapCount());
        }
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Cache;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;

@Service
public class DisciplineCatalogCache {

    public static final long MAX_ENTRIES = 64L;
    public static final Duration TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofMinutes(10);
    private static final String CODES_KEY = "codes";

    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;
    private final Cache<String, CatalogEntry> entries;
    private final Cache<String, List<String>> codes;

    public DisciplineCatalogCache(DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository, MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;
        this.entries = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(MAX_ENTRIES)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build();
        this.codes = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .maximumSize(1L)
                .expireAfterWrite(TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .recordStats()
                .build();
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.entries, "disciplineEntry");
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(meterRegistry, this.codes, "disciplineCodes");
    }

    public Optional<CatalogEntry> find(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return Optional.ofNullable(entries.get(code.trim(), this::loadSingle));
    }

    public List<CatalogEntry> all() {
        List<String> allCodes = codes.get(CODES_KEY, key -> loadCodes());
        // Determine which codes are missing from the entries cache
        List<String> missing = allCodes.stream()
                .filter(code -> entries.getIfPresent(code) == null)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

        if (!missing.isEmpty()) {
            // Bulk load missing disciplines from database
            List<Discipline> disciplines = disciplineRepository.findAllById(missing);
            Map<String, CatalogEntry> loadedMap = new HashMap<>(missing.size());
            for (Discipline d : disciplines) {
                CatalogEntry entry = CatalogEntry.of(d);
                loadedMap.put(d.getCode(), entry);
                // Insert into cache immediately
                entries.put(d.getCode(), entry);
            }
            // For any missing code that was not found in DB, we do nothing (entry stays null)
        }

        // Build result list in code order using the entries cache
        List<CatalogEntry> result = new ArrayList<>(allCodes.size());
        for (String code : allCodes) {
            CatalogEntry entry = entries.getIfPresent(code);
            if (entry != null) {
                result.add(entry);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public void invalidate(String code) {
        if (code != null && !code.isBlank()) {
            entries.invalidate(code.trim());
        }
        codes.invalidate(CODES_KEY);
    }

    public void invalidateAll() {
        entries.invalidateAll();
        codes.invalidateAll();
    }

    public long size() {
        return entries.estimatedSize();
    }

    private CatalogEntry loadSingle(String code) {
        return disciplineRepository.findById(code).map(CatalogEntry::of).orElse(null);
    }

    private List<String> loadCodes() {
        List<Discipline> all = disciplineRepository.findAllByOrderByCodeAsc();
        // Pre-warm the entries cache
        for (Discipline discipline : all) {
            CatalogEntry entry = CatalogEntry.of(discipline);
            entries.put(discipline.getCode(), entry);
        }
        return all.stream().map(Discipline::getCode).collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    public record CatalogEntry(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {
        public static CatalogEntry of(Discipline discipline) {
            return new CatalogEntry(discipline.getCode(), discipline.getTitle(),
                discipline.getUnitLabel(), discipline.getLapCount());
        }
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.CopyOnWriteArrayList;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Discipline;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.DisciplineRepository;

@Service
public class DisciplineCatalogCache {

    public static final long MAX_ENTRIES = 64L;  // kept for backward compatibility, not strictly enforced
    public static final Duration TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofMinutes(10); // kept for documentation

    private final DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository;

    // Volatile references to enable atomic replacement
    private volatile Map<String, CatalogEntry> entriesMap = Collections.emptyMap();
    private volatile List<String> codesList = Collections.emptyList();

    public DisciplineCatalogCache(DisciplineRepository disciplineRepository) {
        this.disciplineRepository = disciplineRepository;
    }

    public Optional<CatalogEntry> find(String code) {
        if (code == null || code.isBlank()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        String trimmed = code.trim();
        CatalogEntry entry = entriesMap.get(trimmed);
        if (entry != null) {
            return Optional.of(entry);
        }
        // Load from database
        return disciplineRepository.findById(trimmed).map(d -> {
            CatalogEntry newEntry = CatalogEntry.of(d);
            // Try to insert into map if still missing
            Map<String, CatalogEntry> current = entriesMap;
            if (!current.containsKey(trimmed)) {
                // Replace the map with a new one that includes the new entry
                Map<String, CatalogEntry> updated = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(current);
                updated.put(trimmed, newEntry);
                entriesMap = updated;
            }
            return newEntry;
        });
    }

    public List<CatalogEntry> all() {
        List<String> currentCodes = codesList;
        Map<String, CatalogEntry> currentEntries = entriesMap;
        if (currentCodes.isEmpty() || currentEntries.isEmpty()) {
            // Load all from database
            List<Discipline> disciplines = disciplineRepository.findAllByOrderByCodeAsc();
            Map<String, CatalogEntry> newEntries = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(disciplines.size());
            List<String> newCodes = new ArrayList<>(disciplines.size());
            for (Discipline d : disciplines) {
                CatalogEntry entry = CatalogEntry.of(d);
                newEntries.put(d.getCode(), entry);
                newCodes.add(d.getCode());
            }
            // Publish atomically
            entriesMap = newEntries;
            codesList = Collections.unmodifiableList(newCodes);
            currentCodes = codesList;
            currentEntries = entriesMap;
        }

        List<CatalogEntry> result = new ArrayList<>(currentCodes.size());
        for (String code : currentCodes) {
            CatalogEntry entry = currentEntries.get(code);
            if (entry != null) {
                result.add(entry);
            }
        }
        return result;
    }

    public void invalidate(String code) {
        if (code != null && !code.isBlank()) {
            String trimmed = code.trim();
            Map<String, CatalogEntry> current = entriesMap;
            if (current.containsKey(trimmed)) {
                Map<String, CatalogEntry> updated = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(current);
                updated.remove(trimmed);
                entriesMap = updated;
            }
        }
        // Invalidate codes as well
        codesList = Collections.emptyList();
    }

    public void invalidateAll() {
        entriesMap = Collections.emptyMap();
        codesList = Collections.emptyList();
    }

    // size() is not precisely estimated, but we approximate
    public long size() {
        return entriesMap.size();
    }

    public record CatalogEntry(String code, String title, String unitLabel, int lapCount) {
        public static CatalogEntry of(Discipline discipline) {
            return new CatalogEntry(discipline.getCode(), discipline.getTitle(),
                discipline.getUnitLabel(), discipline.getLapCount());
        }
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web;

import java.util.NoSuchElementException;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;

import org.springframework.web.method.annotation.MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException;

import org.springframework.web.servlet.resource.NoResourceFoundException;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.validation.DisciplineResolver;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.validation.HeaderGuard;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto.ErrorDto;

@RestControllerAdvice
public class ApiExceptionHandler {

    /** Атрибут запроса с идентификатором обращения; его же значение уходит в {@code X-Trace-Id}. */
    public static final String TRACE_ID_ATTRIBUTE = "raceboard.traceId";

    /** Заголовок ответа с идентификатором обращения. */
    public static final String TRACE_ID_HEADER = "X-Trace-Id";

    /** Атрибут запроса с названием дисциплины, к которой отнесён запрос. */
    public static final String DISCIPLINE_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE = "raceboard.disciplineTitle";

    private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ApiExceptionHandler.class);

    /** Код ошибки нарушенных ограничений запроса. */
    private static final String VALIDATION_FAILED = "VALIDATION_FAILED";

    /** Код ошибки для несуществующего пути. */
    private static final String NOT_FOUND = "NOT_FOUND";

    /** Код ошибки, которую приложение не отнесло ни к одному случаю контракта. */
    private static final String INTERNAL_ERROR = "INTERNAL_ERROR";

    /** Код ошибки для дисциплины, которой нет в справочнике. */
    private static final String DISCIPLINE_UNKNOWN = "DISCIPLINE_UNKNOWN";

    /** Вид кода контракта: заглавные буквы, цифры и подчёркивание. */
    private static final Pattern CONTRACT_CODE = Pattern.compile("[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*");

    private final DisciplineResolver disciplineResolver;

    public ApiExceptionHandler(DisciplineResolver disciplineResolver) {
        this.disciplineResolver = disciplineResolver;
    }

    @ModelAttribute
    public void disciplineContext(HttpServletRequest request) {
        String header = request.getHeader(HeaderGuard.DISCIPLINE_HEADER);
        DisciplineResolver.ResolvedDiscipline resolved = resolveDiscipline(header);
        if (resolved.unknown()) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, DISCIPLINE_UNKNOWN,
                    "Discipline " + resolved.code() + " is not in the catalogue");
        }
        request.setAttribute(DISCIPLINE_TITLE_ATTRIBUTE, resolved.title());
    }

    @Cacheable(value = "disciplines", unless = "#result == null")
    protected DisciplineResolver.ResolvedDiscipline resolveDiscipline(String code) {
        return disciplineResolver.resolve(code);
    }

    // ---------- All other @ExceptionHandler methods remain identical ----------

    @ExceptionHandler(ApiException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleApi(ApiException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, e.getStatus(), e.getCode(), e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(NoSuchElementException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleMissing(NoSuchElementException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, contractCode(e.getMessage(), NOT_FOUND), e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleBodyValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException e,
                                                         HttpServletRequest request) {
        String message = e.getBindingResult().getFieldError() == null
                ? "Request body is invalid"
                : e.getBindingResult().getFieldError().getField() + ": "
                        + e.getBindingResult().getFieldError().getDefaultMessage();
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, message);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({ConstraintViolationException.class, HandlerMethodValidationException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleParameterValidation(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, "Request parameters are invalid");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({MissingServletRequestParameterException.class,
            MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleParameterBinding(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(DataIntegrityViolationException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleIntegrity(DataIntegrityViolationException e,
                                                    HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, "Request violates a data constraint");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleIllegalArgument(IllegalArgumentException e,
                                                          HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, contractCode(e.getMessage(), VALIDATION_FAILED),
                e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({NoHandlerFoundException.class, NoResourceFoundException.class,
            HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleUnknownRoute(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, NOT_FOUND, "Requested endpoint does not exist");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleUnexpected(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        LOG.error("необработанная ошибка запроса", e);
        return body(request, HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR, "Unexpected server error");
    }

    private ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> body(HttpServletRequest request, HttpStatus status,
                                          String code, String message) {
        String traceId = traceIdOf(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(status)
                .body(new ErrorDto(code, message == null ? status.getReasonPhrase() : message, traceId));
    }

    private static String traceIdOf(HttpServletRequest request) {
        Object attribute = request.getAttribute(TRACE_ID_ATTRIBUTE);
        if (attribute instanceof String traceId && !traceId.isBlank()) {
            return traceId;
        }
        String header = request.getHeader(TRACE_ID_HEADER);
        return header == null || header.isBlank() ? null : header;
    }

    private static String contractCode(String message, String defaultCode) {
        if (message == null || message.isBlank()) {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        String head = message.trim().split("[:\\s]", 2)[0];
        return CONTRACT_CODE.matcher(head).matches() ? head : defaultCode;
    }
}

        return body(request, e.getStatus(), e.getCode(), e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(NoSuchElementException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleMissing(NoSuchElementException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, contractCode(e.getMessage(), NOT_FOUND), e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(MethodArgumentNotValidException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleBodyValidation(MethodArgumentNotValidException e,
                                                         HttpServletRequest request) {
        String message = e.getBindingResult().getFieldError() == null
                ? "Request body is invalid"
                : e.getBindingResult().getFieldError().getField() + ": "
                        + e.getBindingResult().getFieldError().getDefaultMessage();
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, message);
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({ConstraintViolationException.class, HandlerMethodValidationException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleParameterValidation(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, "Request parameters are invalid");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({MissingServletRequestParameterException.class,
            MethodArgumentTypeMismatchException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleParameterBinding(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(DataIntegrityViolationException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleIntegrity(DataIntegrityViolationException e,
                                                    HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, VALIDATION_FAILED, "Request violates a data constraint");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(IllegalArgumentException.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleIllegalArgument(IllegalArgumentException e,
                                                          HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, contractCode(e.getMessage(), VALIDATION_FAILED),
                e.getMessage());
    }

    @ExceptionHandler({NoHandlerFoundException.class, NoResourceFoundException.class,
            HttpRequestMethodNotSupportedException.class})
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleUnknownRoute(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        return body(request, HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, NOT_FOUND, "Requested endpoint does not exist");
    }

    @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
    public ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> handleUnexpected(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
        LOG.error("необработанная ошибка запроса", e);
        return body(request, HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR, INTERNAL_ERROR, "Unexpected server error");
    }

    private ResponseEntity<ErrorDto> body(HttpServletRequest request, HttpStatus status,
                                          String code, String message) {
        String traceId = traceIdOf(request);
        return ResponseEntity.status(status)
                .body(new ErrorDto(code, message == null ? status.getReasonPhrase() : message, traceId));
    }

    private static String traceIdOf(HttpServletRequest request) {
        Object attribute = request.getAttribute(TRACE_ID_ATTRIBUTE);
        if (attribute instanceof String traceId && !traceId.isBlank()) {
            return traceId;
        }
        String header = request.getHeader(TRACE_ID_HEADER);
        return header == null || header.isBlank() ? null : header;
    }

    /**
     * Extracts the first word from the message that matches the contract code pattern
     * using simple character iteration instead of regular expressions.
     */
    private static String contractCode(String message, String defaultCode) {
        if (message == null || message.isEmpty()) {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        // Skip leading whitespace
        int start = 0;
        int len = message.length();
        while (start < len && message.charAt(start) <= ' ') {
            start++;
        }
        if (start >= len) {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        char first = message.charAt(start);
        if (first < 'A' || first > 'Z') {
            return defaultCode;
        }
        int end = start + 1;
        while (end < len) {
            char c = message.charAt(end);
            if (c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z') {
                end++;
            } else if (c >= '0' && c <= '9') {
                end++;
            } else if (c == '_') {
                end++;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return message.substring(start, end);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Refactored with batch loading of runner labels (only those actually referenced)
 * and upfront map lookup to avoid loading all runners.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // First, get the field rows (raw runnerIds)
        List<Object[]> rawRows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", primary)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        // Collect distinct runner IDs
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            runnerIds.add((Long) row[0]);
        }

        // Batch load only those runners
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labelMap = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size() * 2);
        if (!runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
            for (Runner r : runners) {
                labelMap.put(r.getId(), new RunnerLabel(r.getBib(), r.getClub(), r.getFullName()));
            }
        }

        // Build field entries
        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labelMap.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

// ============================================================
// [VARIANT_3] Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;

/**
 * Refactored with low-overhead primitives: use parallel arrays for sorting,
 * compile regex patterns once, avoid boxing in hot paths.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    // Cached signature function – avoids recomputation per entry
    private final ToIntFunction<AttemptEntry> signatureFunc;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        // Pre-compute a comparator that uses primitive int signatures
        this.signatureFunc = entry -> attemptRanker.signature(entry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // Load field with manual primitive array to avoid boxing overhead
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        List<AttemptEntry> field = loadField(primary, from, to);
        // Use primitive-aware sorting via custom comparator that caches signature
        // Instead of sorting via list.sort, we can sort by signature using an int array
        int n = field.size();
        int[] signatures = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            signatures[i] = signatureFunc.applyAsInt(field.get(i));
        }
        // Sort indices based on signatures (primitive sort)
        Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) indices[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(signatures[a], signatures[b]));
        // Reorder field list accordingly (mutate)
        Object[] fieldArray = field.toArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field.set(i, (AttemptEntry) fieldArray[indices[i]]);
        }
        long duration = System.nanoTime() - start;
        rankTimer.record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);

        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    // Reuse static map for labels (loaded once per summary call, but we can cache if needed)
    // Actually loadRunnerLabels remains same but could be optimized with primitive maps
    private List<AttemptEntry> loadField(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labels = loadRunnerLabels();
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", disciplineCode)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labels.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return field;
    }

    private Map<Long, RunnerLabel> loadRunnerLabels() {
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select r.id, r.bib, r.club, r.fullName from Runner r", Object[].class)
                .getResultList();
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> byId = new HashMap<>(rows.size() * 2);
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            byId.put((Long) row[0], new RunnerLabel((String) row[1], (String) row[2], (String) row[3]));
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        // Use primitive-based accumulator map (e.g., String->FieldAccumulator)
        // Already using LinkedHashMap, which is fine; could use Object2ObjectOpenHashMap for speed
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

                .map(RunnerDto::of);
    }

                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)

/**
 * Бегуны: список заявки, карточка по стартовому номеру, свод за период и регистрация бегуна.
 */
@RestController
@RequestMapping("/api/v1/runners")
public class RunnerController {

    private static final Pattern SPACES = Pattern.compile("\\s+");
    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 20;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final BibLookupService bibLookupService;
    private final RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService;
    private final int pageMaxSize; // cached from properties

    public RunnerController(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                            BibLookupService bibLookupService,
                            RunnerSummaryService runnerSummaryService,
                            AppProperties properties) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.bibLookupService = bibLookupService;
        this.runnerSummaryService = runnerSummaryService;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    @GetMapping
    public Page<RunnerDto> list(@RequestParam(required = false) String q,
                                @RequestParam(required = false) String club,
                                @PageableDefault(size = DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, sort = "bib", direction = Sort.Direction.ASC)
                                Pageable pageable) {
        // Use raw int for size limit, avoid method call overhead
        int maxSize = pageMaxSize;
        int requestedSize = pageable.getPageSize();
        Pageable page = (requestedSize > maxSize)
                ? Pageable.ofSize(maxSize).withPage(pageable.getPageNumber())
                : pageable;
        return runnerRepository.search(
                trimOrNull(q),
                trimOrNull(club),
                page
        ).map(RunnerDto::of);
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}")
    public RunnerDto byBib(@PathVariable String bib) {
        return bibLookupService.findRunner(bib)
                .map(RunnerDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @GetMapping("/{bib}/summary")
    public RunnerSummaryDto summary(@PathVariable String bib,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate from,
                                    @RequestParam(required = false)
                                    @DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE) LocalDate to) {
        ApiRequests.requireRange(from, to);
        return runnerSummaryService.summary(bib, ApiRequests.startOfDay(from), ApiRequests.endOfDay(to))
                .map(RunnerSummaryDto::of)
                .orElseThrow(() -> runnerNotFound(bib));
    }

    @PostMapping
    public ResponseEntity<RunnerDto> create(@Valid @RequestBody RunnerCreateRequest request) {
        if (bibLookupService.exists(request.bib())) {
            throw new ApiException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, "VALIDATION_FAILED",
                    "Runner " + request.bib() + " already exists");
        }
        Runner runner = new Runner();
        runner.setBib(request.bib().trim());
        runner.setFullName(request.fullName());
        runner.setClub(request.club());
        runner.setRegisteredOn(request.registeredOn());
        runner.setActive(true);
        return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.CREATED).body(RunnerDto.of(runnerRepository.save(runner)));
    }

    // Reusable trim logic using precompiled pattern
    private static String trimOrNull(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }
        String trimmed = SPACES.matcher(value).replaceAll("").trim();
        return trimmed.isEmpty() ? null : trimmed;
    }

    private static ApiException runnerNotFound(String bib) {
        return new ApiException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "RUNNER_NOT_FOUND", "Runner " + bib + " not found");
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import jakarta.persistence.EntityGraph;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import jakarta.persistence.TypedQuery;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Поиск бегуна по стартовому номеру с использованием @EntityGraph JOIN FETCH.
 * <p>Использует EntityManager для создания запроса с fetch graph, чтобы избежать N+1
 * при обращении к ленивым ассоциациям Runner. Для других методов (findIdByBib, existsByBib)
 * оставлен оригинальный репозиторий, так как они не загружают сущности.</p>
 */
@Service
public class BibLookupService {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public BibLookupService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
    }

    /**
     * Идентификатор бегуна по стартовому номеру.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return идентификатор или пустой результат, если такого номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Long> findRunnerId(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return runnerRepository.findIdByBib(normalized);
    }

    /**
     * Идентификатор бегуна по стартовому номеру; номера обязаны существовать.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return идентификатор бегуна
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException если номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long requireRunnerId(String bib) {
        return findRunnerId(bib)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("бегун со стартовым номером не найден: " + bib));
    }

    /**
     * Бегун по стартовому номеру с использованием fetch graph для загрузки всех ассоциаций.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return бегун или пустой результат, если такого номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Runner> findRunner(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        // Используем EntityManager для построения запроса с fetch graph
        // Предполагаем, что Runner имеет ассоциации country, club, etc.
        EntityGraph<Runner> graph = entityManager.createEntityGraph(Runner.class);
        graph.addAttributeNodes("country", "club", "category"); // пример – укажите реальные имена полей
        Map<String, Object> hints = new HashMap<>();
        hints.put("jakarta.persistence.fetchgraph", graph);

        Runner runner = entityManager.find(Runner.class, runnerRepository.findIdByBib(normalized).orElse(null), hints);
        return Optional.ofNullable(runner);
    }

    /**
     * Есть ли в заявке бегун с таким стартовым номером.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return {@code true}, если номер занят
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public boolean exists(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        return normalized != null && runnerRepository.existsByBib(normalized);
    }

    /** Стартовый номер без окружающих пробелов; {@code null} для незаданного номера. */
    private static String normalize(String bib) {
        if (bib == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String trimmed = bib.trim();
        return trimmed.isEmpty() ? null : trimmed;
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import jakarta.annotation.PostConstruct;
import org.springframework.scheduling.annotation.Scheduled;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;

/**
 * Поиск бегуна по стартовому номеру с кэшированием результатов.
 * <p>Используется ConcurrentHashMap для хранения соответствий bib → Runner и bib → ID.
 * Кэш обновляется при старте и периодически (каждые 5 минут), чтобы избежать устаревания данных.
 * Это снижает нагрузку на базу данных при частых запросах одних и тех же номеров.</p>
 */
@Service
public class BibLookupService {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;

    // Кэш для соответствия bib → Runner (сущность)
    private final Map<String, Runner> runnerCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    // Кэш для соответствия bib → ID (чтобы не загружать сущность)
    private final Map<String, Long> idCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();

    public BibLookupService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
    }

    /**
     * Заполняет кэш из базы данных при старте.
     */
    @PostConstruct
    public void populateCache() {
        List<Runner> allRunners = runnerRepository.findAll(); // однократная загрузка всех бегунов
        for (Runner runner : allRunners) {
            String normalized = normalize(runner.getBib());
            if (normalized != null) {
                runnerCache.put(normalized, runner);
                idCache.put(normalized, runner.getId());
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Периодический refresh кэша (каждые 5 минут). В реальном приложении – подписка на события.
     */
    @Scheduled(fixedDelay = 300_000, initialDelay = 300_000)
    public void refreshCache() {
        runnerCache.clear();
        idCache.clear();
        List<Runner> allRunners = runnerRepository.findAll();
        for (Runner runner : allRunners) {
            String normalized = normalize(runner.getBib());
            if (normalized != null) {
                runnerCache.put(normalized, runner);
                idCache.put(normalized, runner.getId());
            }
        }
    }

    /**
     * Идентификатор бегуна по стартовому номеру (из кэша).
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return идентификатор или пустой результат, если такого номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Long> findRunnerId(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Long id = idCache.get(normalized);
        if (id != null) {
            return Optional.of(id);
        }
        // Fallback для только что добавленных номеров
        Optional<Long> fromDb = runnerRepository.findIdByBib(normalized);
        fromDb.ifPresent(value -> idCache.put(normalized, value));
        return fromDb;
    }

    /**
     * Идентификатор бегуна по стартовому номеру; номера обязаны существовать.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return идентификатор бегуна
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException если номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long requireRunnerId(String bib) {
        return findRunnerId(bib)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("бегун со стартовым номером не найден: " + bib));
    }

    /**
     * Бегун по стартовому номеру (из кэша).
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return бегун или пустой результат, если такого номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Runner> findRunner(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = runnerCache.get(normalized);
        if (runner != null) {
            return Optional.of(runner);
        }
        // Fallback
        Optional<Runner> fromDb = runnerRepository.findByBib(normalized);
        fromDb.ifPresent(r -> runnerCache.put(normalized, r));
        return fromDb;
    }

    /**
     * Есть ли в заявке бегун с таким стартовым номером.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return {@code true}, если номер занят
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public boolean exists(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return false;
        }
        return idCache.containsKey(normalized) || runnerRepository.existsByBib(normalized);
    }

    /** Стартовый номер без окружающих пробелов; {@code null} для незаданного номера. */
    private static String normalize(String bib) {
        if (bib == null) {
            return null;
        }
        String trimmed = bib.trim();
        return trimmed.isEmpty() ? null : trimmed;
    }

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Поиск бегуна по стартовому номеру с низкими накладными расходами.
 * <p>Убрана аннотация @Transactional с простых read-only методов (findRunnerId, exists),
 * так как они не изменяют данные и не требуют транзакционного контекста (репозиторий
 * использует Spring Data, который сам управляет соединениями). Это снижает накладные
 * расходы на создание транзакций при высокой частоте вызовов.
 * Для findRunner оставлена транзакция, чтобы сущность оставалась managed для ленивых
 * ассоциаций. Метод normalize оптимизирован: прямая работа с символами, без вызова trim(),
 * что уменьшает выделение строк.</p>
 */
@Service
public class BibLookupService {

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;

    public BibLookupService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
    }

    /**
     * Идентификатор бегуна по стартовому номеру (без транзакции).
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return идентификатор или пустой результат, если такого номера в заявке нет
     */
    public Optional<Long> findRunnerId(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return runnerRepository.findIdByBib(normalized);
    }

    /**
     * Идентификатор бегуна по стартовому номеру; номера обязаны существовать.
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return идентификатор бегуна
     * @throws IllegalArgumentException если номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public long requireRunnerId(String bib) {
        return findRunnerId(bib)
                .orElseThrow(() -> new IllegalArgumentException("бегун со стартовым номером не найден: " + bib));
    }

    /**
     * Бегун по стартовому номеру (с транзакцией для поддержки managed сущности).
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return бегун или пустой результат, если такого номера в заявке нет
     */
    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Runner> findRunner(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        if (normalized == null) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        return runnerRepository.findByBib(normalized);
    }

    /**
     * Есть ли в заявке бегун с таким стартовым номером (без транзакции).
     *
     * @param bib стартовый номер
     * @return {@code true}, если номер занят
     */
    public boolean exists(String bib) {
        String normalized = normalize(bib);
        return normalized != null && runnerRepository.existsByBib(normalized);
    }

    /** Стартовый номер без окружающих пробелов; {@code null} для пустой строки или null.
     *  Оптимизированная версия: ручное сканирование пробелов для уменьшения аллокаций. */
    private static String normalize(String bib) {
        if (bib == null) {
            return null;
        }
        int start = 0, end = bib.length();
        while (start < end && bib.charAt(start) <= ' ') { // пробельные символы (пробел, табуляция, etc.)
            start++;
        }
        while (end > start && bib.charAt(end - 1) <= ' ') {
            end--;
        }
        if (start == end) {
            return null;
        }
        // Если строка уже без пробелов, избегаем substring (который создаёт новую строку)
        if (start == 0 && end == bib.length()) {
            return bib;
        }
        return bib.substring(start, end);
    }
}

/**
 * Запись трассировки обращения к API.
 *
 * @param route      маршрут запроса
 * @param verb       метод HTTP
 * @param outcome    код ответа
 * @param durationMs время обработки в миллисекундах
 * @param capturedAt момент записи трассы
 * @param traceId    идентификатор обращения
 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    /**
     * Запись ответа по строке трассы.
     *
     * @param trace трасса обращения
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(trace.getRoute(), trace.getVerb(), trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(), trace.getCapturedAt(), trace.getTraceId());
    }

    /**
     * Пакетное преобразование списка трасс в список DTO.
     * Использует предварительно выделенный массив для уменьшения аллокаций.
     *
     * @param traces список трасс
     * @return список DTO
     */
    public static List<TraceDto> fromTraces(List<RequestTrace> traces) {
        if (traces == null || traces.isEmpty()) return List.of();
        final TraceDto[] array = new TraceDto[traces.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < traces.size(); i++) {
            RequestTrace t = traces.get(i);
            array[i] = new TraceDto(t.getRoute(), t.getVerb(), t.getOutcome(),
                    t.getDurationMs(), t.getCapturedAt(), t.getTraceId());
        }
        return List.of(array);
    }
}

/**
 * Запись трассировки обращения к API.
 *
 * @param route      маршрут запроса
 * @param verb       метод HTTP
 * @param outcome    код ответа
 * @param durationMs время обработки в миллисекундах
 * @param capturedAt момент записи трассы (в миллисекундах с эпохи)
 * @param traceId    идентификатор обращения
 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    // Кэшированный экземпляр для пустого/неопределённого момента времени (опционально)
    private static final Instant EMPTY_INSTANT = Instant.ofEpochMilli(0);

    /**
     * Запись ответа по строке трассы.
     *
     * @param trace трасса обращения
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(trace.getRoute(), trace.getVerb(), trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(), trace.getCapturedAt(), trace.getTraceId());
    }

    /**
     * Создаёт DTO из примитивных полей, избегая промежуточного создания Instant.
     * Использует заранее вычисленный Instant для уменьшения аллокаций.
     *
     * @param route           маршрут
     * @param verb            метод HTTP
     * @param outcome         код ответа
     * @param durationMs      время обработки
     * @param capturedAtEpoch момент в миллисекундах с эпохи
     * @param traceId         идентификатор
     * @return DTO
     */
    public static TraceDto fromRaw(String route, String verb, int outcome,
                                    long durationMs, long capturedAtEpoch, String traceId) {
        // Повторное использование одного Instant при нулевом значении
        Instant instant = capturedAtEpoch == 0 ? EMPTY_INSTANT : Instant.ofEpochMilli(capturedAtEpoch);
        return new TraceDto(route, verb, outcome, durationMs, instant, traceId);
    }
}

/**
 * Бегун, заявленный на соревнования.

 * <p>К бегуну привязаны две коллекции, и обе висят на колонке {@code runner_id}:
 * попытки (двусторонняя связь, ведущая сторона — {@link Attempt#getRunner()}) и отсечки
 * (односторонняя связь только на чтение, потому что {@link SplitTime} пишется пакетами
 * и собственной ссылки на бегуна не держит).
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "runner",
        uniqueConstraints = @UniqueConstraint(name = "uk_runner_bib", columnNames = "bib"),
        indexes = @Index(name = "ix_runner_club", columnList = "club")
)
public class Runner {

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "bib", nullable = false, length = 16)
    private String bib;

    @Column(name = "full_name", length = 120)
    private String fullName;

    @Column(name = "club", length = 60)
    private String club;

    @Column(name = "active", nullable = false)
    private boolean active;

    @Column(name = "registered_on")
    private LocalDate registeredOn;

    @OneToMany(mappedBy = "runner", fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @BatchSize(size = 50)
    private List<Attempt> attempts = new ArrayList<>();

    /**
     * Отсечки бегуна. Связь односторонняя и объявлена только на чтение
     * ({@code insertable = false, updatable = false}): владелец колонки {@code runner_id} —
     * сама таблица отсечек. Внешний ключ не создаётся, чтобы схема отсечек не обрастала
     * объектами сверх единственного объявленного индекса.
     */
    @OneToMany(fetch = FetchType.LAZY)
    @JoinColumn(name = "runner_id", insertable = false, updatable = false,
            foreignKey = @ForeignKey(ConstraintMode.NO_CONSTRAINT))
    @BatchSize(size = 50)
    private Set<SplitTime> splits = new LinkedHashSet<>();

    public Runner() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getBib() {
        return bib;
    }

    public void setBib(String bib) {
        this.bib = bib;
    }

    public String getFullName() {
        return fullName;
    }

    public void setFullName(String fullName) {
        this.fullName = fullName;
    }

    public String getClub() {
        return club;
    }

    public void setClub(String club) {
        this.club = club;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }

    public void setActive(boolean active) {
        this.active = active;
    }

    public LocalDate getRegisteredOn() {
        return registeredOn;
    }

    public void setRegisteredOn(LocalDate registeredOn) {
        this.registeredOn = registeredOn;
    }

    public List<Attempt> getAttempts() {
        return attempts;
    }

    public void setAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        this.attempts = attempts;
    }

    public Set<SplitTime> getSplits() {
        return splits;
    }

    public void setSplits(Set<SplitTime> splits) {
        this.splits = splits;
    }

    /** Равенство бегунов определяется идентификатором. */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other) {
        if (this == other) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!(other instanceof Runner)) {
            return false;
        }
        Runner that = (Runner) other;
        return id != null && id.equals(that.id);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return Objects.hashCode(id);
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "Runner{id=" + id + ", bib=" + bib + "}";
    }
}

    // -------- low-overhead caches --------
    private transient volatile int hashCodeCache = 0;

    private transient volatile String toStringCache = null;

    public Runner() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
        // invalidate caches when identity changes
        this.hashCodeCache = 0;
        this.toStringCache = null;
    }

    public String getBib() {
        return bib;
    }

    public void setBib(String bib) {
        this.bib = bib;
        this.toStringCache = null;
    }

    public String getFullName() {
        return fullName;
    }

    public void setFullName(String fullName) {
        this.fullName = fullName;
    }

    public String getClub() {
        return club;
    }

    public void setClub(String club) {
        this.club = club;
    }

    public boolean isActive() {
        return active;
    }

    public void setActive(boolean active) {
        this.active = active;
    }

    public LocalDate getRegisteredOn() {
        return registeredOn;
    }

    public void setRegisteredOn(LocalDate registeredOn) {
        this.registeredOn = registeredOn;
    }

    public List<Attempt> getAttempts() {
        return attempts;
    }

    public void setAttempts(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        this.attempts = attempts;
    }

    public Set<SplitTime> getSplits() {
        return splits;
    }

    public void setSplits(Set<SplitTime> splits) {
        this.splits = splits;
    }

    /** Равенство бегунов определяется идентификатором. */
    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object other) {
        if (this == other) {
            return true;
        }
        if (other == null || getClass() != other.getClass()) {
            return false;
        }
        Runner that = (Runner) other;
        // fast identity check with cached hash (if both have non-null id)
        if (this.hashCodeCache != 0 && that.hashCodeCache != 0 && this.hashCodeCache != that.hashCodeCache) {
            return false;
        }
        return id != null && id.equals(that.id);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        if (hashCodeCache == 0 && id != null) {
            hashCodeCache = id.hashCode();
        }
        return hashCodeCache;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        if (toStringCache == null) {
            toStringCache = "Runner{id=" + id + ", bib=" + bib + "}";
        }
        return toStringCache;
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.SplitTime;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.SplitTimeRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Optional;

/**
 * Постраничное чтение отсечек хронометража для эндпоинта {@code GET /api/v1/splits}.
 *
 * <p>Бизнес-требование: отсечки читаются по номеру круга и по окну времени регистрации.
 * Стартовый номер бегуна не обязателен: если он задан, выборка сужается до одного бегуна,
 * иначе в ответ идут отсечки всех бегунов на этом круге. Размер страницы ограничен сверху
 * границей {@code app.limits.page-max-size}, порядок строк по умолчанию — по идентификатору.</p>
 *
 * <p>Отдельным методом доступно чтение по дисциплине и кругу: этот путь используют виджеты
 * протокола дисциплины, которым окно времени не нужно.</p>
 *
 * <p><b>Оптимизация (Variant 1):</b> Используем JOIN FETCH для загрузки связи Runner в одном
 * запросе, избегая отдельного запроса в RunnerRepository и предотвращая ленивую загрузку
 * при сериализации.</p>
 */
@Service
public class SplitQueryService {

    private static final int DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE = 50;
    private static final Sort DEFAULT_ORDER = Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id");

    private final SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository;
    private final AppProperties properties;

    public SplitQueryService(SplitTimeRepository splitTimeRepository,
                             AppProperties properties) {
        this.splitTimeRepository = splitTimeRepository;
        this.properties = properties;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<SplitTime> find(String runnerBib, int lap, Instant from, Instant to, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = clamp(pageable);
        if (runnerBib != null && !runnerBib.isBlank()) {
            String bib = runnerBib.trim();
            // Единый запрос с JOIN FETCH, RunnerRepository больше не нужен
            return splitTimeRepository.findByRunnerBibAndLapAndRecordedAtBetween(bib, lap, from, to, page);
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.findByLapAndRecordedAtBetween(lap, from, to, page);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<SplitTime> findByDiscipline(String disciplineCode, int lap,
                                           Instant from, Instant to, Pageable pageable) {
        Pageable page = clamp(pageable);
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return Page.empty(page);
        }
        String code = disciplineCode.trim();
        if (from == null || to == null) {
            return splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndLap(code, lap, page);
        }
        return splitTimeRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndLapAndRecordedAtBetween(code, lap, from, to, page);
    }

    private Pageable clamp(Pageable pageable) {
        int max = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, DEFAULT_PAGE_SIZE, DEFAULT_ORDER);
        }
        Sort order = pageable.getSort().isSorted() ? pageable.getSort() : DEFAULT_ORDER;
        int size = Math.min(pageable.getPageSize(), max);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, order);
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import java.time.Instant;
