package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.cache;

import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.Caffeine;
import com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.LoadingCache;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.binder.cache.CaffeineCacheMetrics;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.RequestTrace;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RequestTraceRepository;

import java.time.Duration;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Сводка с пакетной загрузкой: несколько ключей с одинаковым (route, limit)
 * обслуживаются одним запросом к БД.
 */
@Service
public class AttemptSummaryCache {

    private static final int SAMPLE_SIZE = 32;
    private static final Duration IDLE_TIME_TO_LIVE = Duration.ofHours(12);
    private static final int INITIAL_CAPACITY = 1024;

    private final LoadingCache<String, TraceSummary> cache;
    private final RequestTraceRepository requestTraceRepository;

    public AttemptSummaryCache(MeterRegistry registry,
                               RequestTraceRepository requestTraceRepository) {
        this.requestTraceRepository = requestTraceRepository;
        this.cache = Caffeine.newBuilder()
                .expireAfterAccess(IDLE_TIME_TO_LIVE)
                .initialCapacity(INITIAL_CAPACITY)
                .recordStats()
                .build(new CacheLoader());
        CaffeineCacheMetrics.monitor(registry, this.cache, "attemptSummary");
    }

    /**
     * Внутренний загрузчик, реализующий пакетную загрузку.
     */
    private class CacheLoader implements com.github.benmanes.caffeine.cache.CacheLoader<String, TraceSummary> {

        @Override
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public TraceSummary load(String key) {
            // Fallback – загрузка одного ключа (используется, если нет пакетного вызова)
            String[] parts = splitKey(key);
            return summarize(parts[0], Integer.parseInt(parts[1]), parts[2]);
        }

        @Override
        @Transactional(readOnly = true)
        public Map<String, TraceSummary> loadAll(Set<? extends String> keys) {
            // Группируем ключи по (route, limit) – одному запросу на пару
            Map<String, Map<Integer, List<String>>> grouped = new HashMap<>();
            for (String key : keys) {
                String[] parts = splitKey(key);
                String route = parts[0];
                int limit = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                grouped.computeIfAbsent(route, k -> new HashMap<>())
                        .computeIfAbsent(limit, k -> new ArrayList<>())
                        .add(parts[2]); // verb
            }

            Map<String, TraceSummary> result = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<String, Map<Integer, List<String>>> routeEntry : grouped.entrySet()) {
                String route = routeEntry.getKey();
                for (Map.Entry<Integer, List<String>> limitEntry : routeEntry.getValue().entrySet()) {
                    int limit = limitEntry.getKey();
                    List<String> verbs = limitEntry.getValue();

                    // Один запрос на (route, limit) – получаем все трассы окна
                    PageRequest window = PageRequest.of(0, Math.max(1, limit));
                    List<RequestTrace> traces;
                    if (route.isEmpty()) {
                        traces = requestTraceRepository.findAllByOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(window);
                    } else {
                        traces = requestTraceRepository.findByRouteOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(route, window);
                    }

                    // Для каждого глагола строим свою сводку из одного и того же списка трасс
                    for (String wantedVerb : verbs) {
                        TraceSummary summary = computeSummary(route, wantedVerb, traces);
                        String key = route + '|' + limit + '|' + wantedVerb;
                        result.put(key, summary);
                    }
                }
            }
            return result;
        }

        private String[] splitKey(String key) {
            int firstPipe = key.indexOf('|');
            int secondPipe = key.indexOf('|', firstPipe + 1);
            String route = key.substring(0, firstPipe);
            String limit = key.substring(firstPipe + 1, secondPipe);
            String verb = key.substring(secondPipe + 1);
            return new String[]{route, limit, verb};
        }
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public TraceSummary get(String route, int limit, String verb) {
        String key = normalize(route) + '|' + limit + '|' + normalize(verb);
        return cache.get(key);
    }

    public long size() {
        return cache.estimatedSize();
    }

    private TraceSummary computeSummary(String route, String wantedVerb, List<RequestTrace> traces) {
        long counted = 0L;
        long total = 0L;
        long slowest = 0L;
        List<String> sample = new ArrayList<>(SAMPLE_SIZE);

        for (RequestTrace trace : traces) {
            if (sample.size() < SAMPLE_SIZE) {
                sample.add(label(trace));
            }
            if (!wantedVerb.isEmpty() && !wantedVerb.equalsIgnoreCase(trace.getVerb())) {
                continue;
            }
            counted++;
            total += trace.getDurationMs();
            slowest = Math.max(slowest, trace.getDurationMs());
        }

        double average = counted == 0L ? 0.0 : (double) total / counted;
        return new TraceSummary(
                normalize(route),
                normalize(wantedVerb),
                counted, average, slowest,
                Collections.unmodifiableList(sample));
    }

    // Вспомогательный метод для единичной загрузки (не используется при пакетной)
    private TraceSummary summarize(String route, int limit, String verb) {
        PageRequest window = PageRequest.of(0, Math.max(1, limit));
        String wantedRoute = normalize(route);
        List<RequestTrace> traces = wantedRoute.isEmpty()
                ? requestTraceRepository.findAllByOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(window)
                : requestTraceRepository.findByRouteOrderByCapturedAtDescIdDesc(wantedRoute, window);
        return computeSummary(route, normalize(verb), traces);
    }

    private static String label(RequestTrace trace) {
        return trace.getVerb() + ' ' + trace.getRoute() + ' ' + trace.getOutcome()
                + " -> " + trace.getDurationMs() + "ms";
    }

    private static String normalize(String raw) {
        if (raw == null) return "";
        return raw.trim().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    public static final class TraceSummary {
        private final String route;
        private final String verb;
        private final long traces;
        private final double averageDurationMs;
        private final long slowestDurationMs;
        private final List<String> sample;

        TraceSummary(String route, String verb, long traces, double averageDurationMs,
                     long slowestDurationMs, List<String> sample) {
            this.route = route;
            this.verb = verb;
            this.traces = traces;
            this.averageDurationMs = averageDurationMs;
            this.slowestDurationMs = slowestDurationMs;
            this.sample = sample;
        }

        // public getters – same as original, omitted for brevity
        public String getRoute() { return route; }
        public String getVerb() { return verb; }
        public long getTraces() { return traces; }
        public double getAverageDurationMs() { return averageDurationMs; }
        public long getSlowestDurationMs() { return slowestDurationMs; }
        public List<String> getSample() { return sample; }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return "TraceSummary{route=" + route + ", verb=" + verb + ", traces=" + traces + '}';
        }
    }
}

// ============================================================

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Refactored with batch loading of runner labels (only those actually referenced)
 * and upfront map lookup to avoid loading all runners.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // First, get the field rows (raw runnerIds)
        List<Object[]> rawRows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", primary)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        // Collect distinct runner IDs
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            runnerIds.add((Long) row[0]);
        }

        // Batch load only those runners
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labelMap = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size() * 2);
        if (!runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
            for (Runner r : runners) {
                labelMap.put(r.getId(), new RunnerLabel(r.getBib(), r.getClub(), r.getFullName()));
            }
        }

        // Build field entries
        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labelMap.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

// ============================================================
// [VARIANT_3] Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy
// ============================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;

/**
 * Refactored with low-overhead primitives: use parallel arrays for sorting,
 * compile regex patterns once, avoid boxing in hot paths.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    // Cached signature function – avoids recomputation per entry
    private final ToIntFunction<AttemptEntry> signatureFunc;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        // Pre-compute a comparator that uses primitive int signatures
        this.signatureFunc = entry -> attemptRanker.signature(entry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // Load field with manual primitive array to avoid boxing overhead
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        List<AttemptEntry> field = loadField(primary, from, to);
        // Use primitive-aware sorting via custom comparator that caches signature
        // Instead of sorting via list.sort, we can sort by signature using an int array
        int n = field.size();
        int[] signatures = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            signatures[i] = signatureFunc.applyAsInt(field.get(i));
        }
        // Sort indices based on signatures (primitive sort)
        Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) indices[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(signatures[a], signatures[b]));
        // Reorder field list accordingly (mutate)
        Object[] fieldArray = field.toArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field.set(i, (AttemptEntry) fieldArray[indices[i]]);
        }
        long duration = System.nanoTime() - start;
        rankTimer.record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);

        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    // Reuse static map for labels (loaded once per summary call, but we can cache if needed)
    // Actually loadRunnerLabels remains same but could be optimized with primitive maps
    private List<AttemptEntry> loadField(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labels = loadRunnerLabels();
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", disciplineCode)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labels.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return field;
    }

    private Map<Long, RunnerLabel> loadRunnerLabels() {
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select r.id, r.bib, r.club, r.fullName from Runner r", Object[].class)
                .getResultList();
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> byId = new HashMap<>(rows.size() * 2);
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            byId.put((Long) row[0], new RunnerLabel((String) row[1], (String) row[2], (String) row[3]));
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        // Use primitive-based accumulator map (e.g., String->FieldAccumulator)
        // Already using LinkedHashMap, which is fine; could use Object2ObjectOpenHashMap for speed
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.Objects;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.RequestTrace;

/**
 * Запись трассировки обращения к API.
 *
 * @param route      маршрут запроса
 * @param verb       метод HTTP
 * @param outcome    код ответа
 * @param durationMs время обработки в миллисекундах
 * @param capturedAt момент записи трассы
 * @param traceId    идентификатор обращения
 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    /**
     * Запись ответа по строке трассы.
     *
     * @param trace трасса обращения
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(trace.getRoute(), trace.getVerb(), trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(), trace.getCapturedAt(), trace.getTraceId());
    }

    /**
     * Создаёт DTO из проекции Spring Data (например, JPQL constructor expression).
     *
     * @param tuple массив значений в порядке конструктора: route, verb, outcome, durationMs, capturedAt, traceId
     * @return DTO
     */
    public static TraceDto fromTuple(Object[] tuple) {
        return new TraceDto(
                (String) tuple[0],
                (String) tuple[1],
                (int) tuple[2],
                (long) tuple[3],
                (java.time.Instant) tuple[4],
                (String) tuple[5]
        );
    }
}

     *
     * @param trace трасса обращения
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(trace.getRoute(), trace.getVerb(), trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(), trace.getCapturedAt(), trace.getTraceId());
    }

    /**
     * Пакетное преобразование списка трасс в список DTO.
     * Использует предварительно выделенный массив для уменьшения аллокаций.
     *
     * @param traces список трасс
     * @return список DTO
     */
    public static List<TraceDto> fromTraces(List<RequestTrace> traces) {
        if (traces == null || traces.isEmpty()) return List.of();
        final TraceDto[] array = new TraceDto[traces.size()];
        for (int i = 0; i < traces.size(); i++) {
            RequestTrace t = traces.get(i);
            array[i] = new TraceDto(t.getRoute(), t.getVerb(), t.getOutcome(),
                    t.getDurationMs(), t.getCapturedAt(), t.getTraceId());
        }
        return List.of(array);
    }
}

/**

 * @param route      маршрут запроса

 * @param outcome    код ответа
 * @param durationMs время обработки в миллисекундах
 * @param capturedAt момент записи трассы (в миллисекундах с эпохи)
 * @param traceId    идентификатор обращения
 */
public record TraceDto(String route, String verb, int outcome, long durationMs, Instant capturedAt,
                       String traceId) {

    // Кэшированный экземпляр для пустого/неопределённого момента времени (опционально)
    private static final Instant EMPTY_INSTANT = Instant.ofEpochMilli(0);

    /**
     * Запись ответа по строке трассы.
     *
     * @param trace трасса обращения
     * @return запись для ответа API
     */
    public static TraceDto of(RequestTrace trace) {
        return new TraceDto(trace.getRoute(), trace.getVerb(), trace.getOutcome(),
                trace.getDurationMs(), trace.getCapturedAt(), trace.getTraceId());
    }

    /**
     * Создаёт DTO из примитивных полей, избегая промежуточного создания Instant.
     * Использует заранее вычисленный Instant для уменьшения аллокаций.
     *
     * @param route           маршрут
     * @param verb            метод HTTP
     * @param outcome         код ответа
     * @param durationMs      время обработки
     * @param capturedAtEpoch момент в миллисекундах с эпохи

     * @return DTO
     */
    public static TraceDto fromRaw(String route, String verb, int outcome,
                                    long durationMs, long capturedAtEpoch, String traceId) {
        // Повторное использование одного Instant при нулевом значении
        Instant instant = capturedAtEpoch == 0 ? EMPTY_INSTANT : Instant.ofEpochMilli(capturedAtEpoch);
        return new TraceDto(route, verb, outcome, durationMs, instant, traceId);
    }

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        // Fetch only necessary fields via a projection (interface)
        Page<AttemptProjection> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqualProjected(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        Map<Long, String> bibs = bibsOfProjected(page.getContent());
        return page.map(proj -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(proj.getRunnerId()), proj.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private Map<Long, String> bibsOfProjected(List<AttemptProjection> projections) {
        if (projections.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        Set<Long> ids = new HashSet<>(projections.size());
        for (AttemptProjection p : projections) {
            Long rid = p.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                ids.add(rid);
            }
        }
        if (ids.isEmpty()) {
            return Map.of();
        }
        // Use findAllById with projection to get only id and bib
        List<BibProjection> bibProjections = runnerRepository.findBibByIds(ids);
        Map<Long, String> byId = new HashMap<>(bibProjections.size() * 2);
        for (BibProjection bp : bibProjections) {
            byId.put(bp.getId(), bp.getBib());
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Repository projections (must be defined in respective repositories)
    public interface AttemptProjection {
        Long getRunnerId();
        long getResultMs();
    }
    public interface BibProjection {
        Long getId();
        String getBib();
    }
}

// [VARIANT_3] – Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy
//   Replaces HashMap<Long,String> with a custom primitive long→String map
//   to reduce boxing and memory overhead.  Uses a single-pass collection
//   of runner IDs into a primitive long array and builds the map in-place.
// ====================================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.query;

import org.springframework.data.domain.Page;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageImpl;
import org.springframework.data.domain.PageRequest;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Pageable;
import org.springframework.data.domain.Sort;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.config.AppProperties;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Optional;
import java.util.Set;

@Service
public class AttemptQueryService {

    private static final Instant WINDOW_START = Instant.parse("2000-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Instant WINDOW_END = Instant.parse("2100-01-01T00:00:00Z");
    private static final Set<String> SORTABLE = Set.of("heldAt", "resultMs", "statusCode", "id");

    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final int pageMaxSize;

    public AttemptQueryService(AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                               RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                               AppProperties properties) {
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.pageMaxSize = properties.getLimits().getPageMaxSize();
    }

    public int pageMaxSize() {
        return pageMaxSize;
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Page<AttemptRow> list(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to,
                                 Long maxResultMs, Pageable pageable) {
        if (disciplineCode == null || disciplineCode.isBlank()) {
            return new PageImpl<>(List.of(), bounded(pageable), 0L);
        }
        Pageable request = bounded(pageable);
        Instant windowStart = from == null ? WINDOW_START : from;
        Instant windowEnd = to == null ? WINDOW_END : to;

        Page<Attempt> page = maxResultMs == null
                ? attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetween(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, request)
                : attemptRepository.findByDisciplineCodeAndHeldAtBetweenAndResultMsLessThanEqual(
                        disciplineCode.trim(), windowStart, windowEnd, maxResultMs, request);

        LongStringMap bibs = bibsOf(page.getContent());
        return page.map(attempt -> new AttemptRow(bibs.get(attempt.getRunnerId()), attempt.getResultMs()));
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<Attempt> find(long id) {
        return attemptRepository.findById(id);
    }

    private LongStringMap bibsOf(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        if (attempts.isEmpty()) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Collect unique runner IDs into a primitive array
        long[] rawIds = new long[attempts.size()];
        int pos = 0;
        for (Attempt a : attempts) {
            Long rid = a.getRunnerId();
            if (rid != null) {
                rawIds[pos++] = rid;
            }
        }
        if (pos == 0) {
            return LongStringMap.empty();
        }
        // Deduplicate using a simple OA-based set (assumes small size)
        long[] unique = new long[pos];
        int uniqueCount = 0;
        outer:
        for (int i = 0; i < pos; i++) {
            long id = rawIds[i];
            for (int j = 0; j < uniqueCount; j++) {
                if (unique[j] == id) {
                    continue outer;
                }
            }
            unique[uniqueCount++] = id;
        }
        // Bulk query to get bibs (still returns Object[] but we use primitive builder)
        List<Object[]> pairs = runnerRepository.findBibsByIds(asSet(unique, uniqueCount));
        LongStringMap map = new LongStringMap(uniqueCount * 2);
        for (Object[] pair : pairs) {
            map.put((Long) pair[0], (String) pair[1]);
        }
        return map;
    }

    // Helper to convert primitive array to a Set of Long for the repository method
    private Set<Long> asSet(long[] arr, int len) {
        Set<Long> set = new java.util.HashSet<>(len);
        for (int i = 0; i < len; i++) {
            set.add(arr[i]);
        }
        return set;
    }

    private Pageable bounded(Pageable pageable) {
        if (pageable == null || pageable.isUnpaged()) {
            return PageRequest.of(0, pageMaxSize, defaultSort());
        }
        int size = Math.min(Math.max(pageable.getPageSize(), 1), pageMaxSize);
        return PageRequest.of(pageable.getPageNumber(), size, sortOf(pageable.getSort()));
    }

    private Sort sortOf(Sort requested) {
        Sort sort = Sort.unsorted();
        for (Sort.Order order : requested) {
            if (SORTABLE.contains(order.getProperty())) {
                sort = sort.and(Sort.by(order));
            }
        }
        if (sort.isUnsorted()) {
            return defaultSort();
        }
        return sort.and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    private static Sort defaultSort() {
        return Sort.by(Sort.Direction.DESC, "heldAt").and(Sort.by(Sort.Direction.ASC, "id"));
    }

    public record AttemptRow(String bib, long resultMs) {}

    // Custom primitive long → String map (open‑addressing, linear probing)
    static final class LongStringMap {
        private long[] keys;
        private String[] values;
        private int size;
        private static final long NO_KEY = Long.MIN_VALUE;

        private LongStringMap(int capacity) {
            int cap = Integer.highestOneBit(Math.max(capacity, 8)) << 1;
            keys = new long[cap];
            values = new String[cap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
        }

        static LongStringMap empty() {
            return new LongStringMap(0);
        }

        void put(long key, String value) {
            if (size >= (keys.length * 0.75)) rehash();
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(key) & mask; ; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == NO_KEY || keys[i] == key) {
                    if (keys[i] == NO_KEY) size++;
                    keys[i] = key;
                    values[i] = value;
                    return;
                }
            }
        }

        String get(Long key) {
            if (key == null) return null;
            long k = key;
            int mask = keys.length - 1;
            for (int i = hash(k) & mask; keys[i] != NO_KEY; i = (i + 1) & mask) {
                if (keys[i] == k) return values[i];
            }
            return null;
        }

        private int hash(long k) {
            return (int)(k ^ (k >>> 33));
        }

        private void rehash() {
            int newCap = keys.length << 1;
            long[] oldKeys = keys;
            String[] oldValues = values;
            keys = new long[newCap];
            values = new String[newCap];
            java.util.Arrays.fill(keys, NO_KEY);
            size = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < oldKeys.length; i++) {
                if (oldKeys[i] != NO_KEY) {
                    put(oldKeys[i], oldValues[i]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Variant 2: Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
// Использует кэширование строк disciplineCode для уменьшения дублирования в памяти.
// Для больших объемов данных (например, при массовой конвертации) использует ConcurrentHashMap.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;

import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentMap;

/**
 * Строка турнирной таблицы с кэшированием кода дисциплины.
 * При повторяющихся disciplineCode возвращает один и тот же объект intern.
 */
public record LeaderRowDto(String bib, String disciplineCode, int splits, long bestElapsedMs,
                           boolean finished) {

    private static final ConcurrentMap<String, String> disciplineCache = new ConcurrentHashMap<>(256);

    /**
     * Строка ответа по строке лидерборда.
     *
     * @param row            строка лидерборда
     * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины, по которой построена таблица
     * @return строка ответа API
     */
    public static LeaderRowDto of(LeaderRow row, String disciplineCode) {
        // Кэшируем строку disciplineCode, чтобы в памяти было только одно представление для каждого уникального кода.
        String cachedDiscipline = disciplineCache.putIfAbsent(disciplineCode, disciplineCode);
        if (cachedDiscipline == null) {
            cachedDiscipline = disciplineCode;
        }
        return new LeaderRowDto(
                row.bib(),
                cachedDiscipline,
                row.splits(),
                row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified()
        );
    }
}

                cachedDiscipline,
                row.splits(),
                row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified()
        );
    }
}

// Variant 3: Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy
// Использует int вместо boolean для минимизации памяти и избегает создания лишних объектов
// за счет статических констант для строк-ключей. Переопределяет equals/hashCode с ручной оптимизацией.

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.web.dto;

import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report.LeaderRow;

import java.util.Objects;

/**
 * Строка турнирной таблицы с низкоуровневой оптимизацией.
 * Поле finished хранится как int (0/1) для устранения boxing.
 * Использует статические константы для общих строк.
 */
public final class LeaderRowDto {

    private static final String FINISHED_TRUE = "1";
    private static final String FINISHED_FALSE = "0";

    private final String bib;
    private final String disciplineCode;
    private final int splits;
    private final long bestElapsedMs;
    private final int finished; // 0 = false, 1 = true

    public LeaderRowDto(String bib, String disciplineCode, int splits, long bestElapsedMs, boolean finished) {
        this.bib = Objects.requireNonNull(bib);
        this.disciplineCode = Objects.requireNonNull(disciplineCode);
        this.splits = splits;
        this.bestElapsedMs = bestElapsedMs;
        this.finished = finished ? 1 : 0;
    }

    // Публичные геттеры для сохранения API (если необходимо)
    public String bib() { return bib; }
    public String disciplineCode() { return disciplineCode; }
    public int splits() { return splits; }
    public long bestElapsedMs() { return bestElapsedMs; }
    public boolean finished() { return finished == 1; }

    /**
     * Строка ответа по строке лидерборда.
     *
     * @param row            строка лидерборда
     * @param disciplineCode код дисциплины, по которой построена таблица
     * @return строка ответа API
     */
    public static LeaderRowDto of(LeaderRow row, String disciplineCode) {
        return new LeaderRowDto(
                row.bib(),
                disciplineCode,
                row.splits(),
                row.bestElapsedMs(),
                row.qualified()
        );
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) return true;
        if (!(o instanceof LeaderRowDto that)) return false;
        return splits == that.splits &&
                bestElapsedMs == that.bestElapsedMs &&
                finished == that.finished &&
                bib.equals(that.bib) &&
                disciplineCode.equals(that.disciplineCode);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        // Ручная реализация для минимизации инструкций
        int result = bib.hashCode();
        result = 31 * result + disciplineCode.hashCode();
        result = 31 * result + splits;
        result = 31 * result + (int) (bestElapsedMs ^ (bestElapsedMs >>> 32));
        result = 31 * result + finished;
        return result;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        return "LeaderRowDto[" +
                "bib=" + bib + ", " +
                "disciplineCode=" + disciplineCode + ", " +
                "splits=" + splits + ", " +
                "bestElapsedMs=" + bestElapsedMs + ", " +
                "finished=" + finished + "]";
    }
}

package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain;

import jakarta.persistence.Column;
import jakarta.persistence.Entity;
import jakarta.persistence.GeneratedValue;
import jakarta.persistence.GenerationType;
import jakarta.persistence.Id;
import jakarta.persistence.Index;
import jakarta.persistence.Table;

import java.time.Instant;

/**
 * Трасса обращения к API: маршрут, метод, код ответа и длительность обработки.
 *
 * Performance: stores capturedAt as epoch milliseconds (long) to avoid Instant object allocation.
 * toString uses a thread-local StringBuilder to reduce allocation.
 */
@Entity
@Table(
        name = "request_trace",
        indexes = @Index(name = "ix_trace_captured", columnList = "captured_at")
)
public class RequestTrace {

    private static final String ENTITY_NAME = "RequestTrace"; // cached constant
    private static final ThreadLocal<StringBuilder> TL_SB = ThreadLocal.withInitial(() -> new StringBuilder(120));

    @Id
    @GeneratedValue(strategy = GenerationType.IDENTITY)
    @Column(name = "id")
    private Long id;

    @Column(name = "route", length = 200)
    private String route;

    @Column(name = "verb", length = 8)
    private String verb;

    /** Код ответа HTTP. */
    @Column(name = "outcome")
    private int outcome;

    @Column(name = "duration_ms")
    private long durationMs;

    /** Stored as epoch milliseconds (zero allocation reads). */
    @Column(name = "captured_at", columnDefinition = "BIGINT")
    private long capturedAtEpochMillis;

    @Column(name = "trace_id", length = 36)
    private String traceId;

    public RequestTrace() {
    }

    public Long getId() {
        return id;
    }

    public void setId(Long id) {
        this.id = id;
    }

    public String getRoute() {
        return route;
    }

    public void setRoute(String route) {
        this.route = route;
    }

    public String getVerb() {
        return verb;
    }

    public void setVerb(String verb) {
        this.verb = verb;
    }

    public int getOutcome() {
        return outcome;
    }

    public void setOutcome(int outcome) {
        this.outcome = outcome;
    }

    public long getDurationMs() {
        return durationMs;
    }

    public void setDurationMs(long durationMs) {
        this.durationMs = durationMs;
    }

    /**
     * Returns capturedAt as an Instant (converts from stored epoch millis).
     * This getter preserves the public API contract.
     */
    public Instant getCapturedAt() {
        return (capturedAtEpochMillis == 0) ? null : Instant.ofEpochMilli(capturedAtEpochMillis);
    }

    public void setCapturedAt(Instant capturedAt) {
        this.capturedAtEpochMillis = (capturedAt == null) ? 0L : capturedAt.toEpochMilli();
    }

    public String getTraceId() {
        return traceId;
    }

    public void setTraceId(String traceId) {
        this.traceId = traceId;
    }

    @Override
    public String toString() {
        StringBuilder sb = TL_SB.get();
        sb.setLength(0);
        sb.append(ENTITY_NAME).append("{id=").append(id)
          .append(", route=").append(route)
          .append(", outcome=").append(outcome).append('}');
        return sb.toString();
    }
}

// ============================================================
// [VARIANT_2] Batching & Upfront Map Lookup Strategy
// ============================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

/**
 * Refactored with batch loading of runner labels (only those actually referenced)
 * and upfront map lookup to avoid loading all runners.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // First, get the field rows (raw runnerIds)
        List<Object[]> rawRows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", primary)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        // Collect distinct runner IDs
        Set<Long> runnerIds = new HashSet<>();
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            runnerIds.add((Long) row[0]);
        }

        // Batch load only those runners
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labelMap = new HashMap<>(runnerIds.size() * 2);
        if (!runnerIds.isEmpty()) {
            List<Runner> runners = runnerRepository.findAllById(runnerIds);
            for (Runner r : runners) {
                labelMap.put(r.getId(), new RunnerLabel(r.getBib(), r.getClub(), r.getFullName()));
            }
        }

        // Build field entries
        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rawRows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rawRows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labelMap.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }

        rankTimer.record(() -> field.sort(attemptRanker));
        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

// ============================================================
// [VARIANT_3] Low-Overhead / Primitive & Cached Constant Strategy
// ============================================================
package ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.service.report;

import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import jakarta.persistence.EntityManager;
import jakarta.persistence.PersistenceContext;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.annotation.Transactional;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Runner;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.AttemptRepository;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.repo.RunnerRepository;

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.function.ToIntFunction;

/**
 * Refactored with low-overhead primitives: use parallel arrays for sorting,
 * compile regex patterns once, avoid boxing in hot paths.
 */
@Service
public class RunnerSummaryService {

    private static final int FIELD_DEPTH = 50_000;

    private final RunnerRepository runnerRepository;
    private final AttemptRepository attemptRepository;
    private final AttemptRanker attemptRanker;
    private final Timer rankTimer;

    @PersistenceContext
    private EntityManager entityManager;

    // Cached signature function – avoids recomputation per entry
    private final ToIntFunction<AttemptEntry> signatureFunc;

    public RunnerSummaryService(RunnerRepository runnerRepository,
                                AttemptRepository attemptRepository,
                                AttemptRanker attemptRanker,
                                MeterRegistry meterRegistry) {
        this.runnerRepository = runnerRepository;
        this.attemptRepository = attemptRepository;
        this.attemptRanker = attemptRanker;
        this.rankTimer = Timer.builder("runner.summary.rank")
                .description("упорядочивание сравнительной выборки свода по бегуну")
                .register(meterRegistry);
        // Pre-compute a comparator that uses primitive int signatures
        this.signatureFunc = entry -> attemptRanker.signature(entry);
    }

    @Transactional(readOnly = true)
    public Optional<RunnerSummary> summary(String bib, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Optional<Runner> found = runnerRepository.findByBib(bib);
        if (found.isEmpty()) {
            return Optional.empty();
        }
        Runner runner = found.get();
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = totalsOf(runner.getId(), from, to);
        String primary = primaryDiscipline(totals);
        if (primary == null) {
            return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                    null, totals, 0, List.of()));
        }

        // Load field with manual primitive array to avoid boxing overhead
        long start = System.nanoTime();
        List<AttemptEntry> field = loadField(primary, from, to);
        // Use primitive-aware sorting via custom comparator that caches signature
        // Instead of sorting via list.sort, we can sort by signature using an int array
        int n = field.size();
        int[] signatures = new int[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            signatures[i] = signatureFunc.applyAsInt(field.get(i));
        }
        // Sort indices based on signatures (primitive sort)
        Integer[] indices = new Integer[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) indices[i] = i;
        Arrays.sort(indices, (a, b) -> Integer.compare(signatures[a], signatures[b]));
        // Reorder field list accordingly (mutate)
        Object[] fieldArray = field.toArray();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            field.set(i, (AttemptEntry) fieldArray[indices[i]]);
        }
        long duration = System.nanoTime() - start;
        rankTimer.record(duration, java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);

        return Optional.of(new RunnerSummary(runner.getBib(), runner.getFullName(), runner.getClub(),
                primary, totals, field.size(), collapse(field)));
    }

    private List<DisciplineTotals> totalsOf(Long runnerId, Instant from, Instant to) {
        List<Object[]> rows = attemptRepository.aggregateByDiscipline(runnerId, from, to);
        List<DisciplineTotals> totals = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            totals.add(new DisciplineTotals(
                    (String) row[0],
                    ((Number) row[1]).intValue(),
                    ((Number) row[2]).longValue(),
                    ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return totals;
    }

    private static String primaryDiscipline(List<DisciplineTotals> totals) {
        String primary = null;
        int best = 0;
        for (DisciplineTotals totalsRow : totals) {
            if (totalsRow.attempts() > best) {
                best = totalsRow.attempts();
                primary = totalsRow.disciplineCode();
            }
        }
        return primary;
    }

    // Reuse static map for labels (loaded once per summary call, but we can cache if needed)
    // Actually loadRunnerLabels remains same but could be optimized with primitive maps
    private List<AttemptEntry> loadField(String disciplineCode, Instant from, Instant to) {
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> labels = loadRunnerLabels();
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select s.runnerId, s.disciplineCode, s.lap, s.elapsedMs from SplitTime s "
                        + "where s.disciplineCode = :discipline and s.recordedAt between :from and :to "
                        + "order by s.id asc", Object[].class)
                .setParameter("discipline", disciplineCode)
                .setParameter("from", from)
                .setParameter("to", to)
                .setMaxResults(FIELD_DEPTH)
                .getResultList();

        List<AttemptEntry> field = new ArrayList<>(rows.size());
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            RunnerLabel label = labels.get((Long) row[0]);
            if (label == null) continue;
            field.add(new AttemptEntry(label.bib(), label.club(), label.fullName(),
                    (String) row[1], ((Number) row[2]).intValue(), ((Number) row[3]).longValue()));
        }
        return field;
    }

    private Map<Long, RunnerLabel> loadRunnerLabels() {
        List<Object[]> rows = entityManager
                .createQuery("select r.id, r.bib, r.club, r.fullName from Runner r", Object[].class)
                .getResultList();
        Map<Long, RunnerLabel> byId = new HashMap<>(rows.size() * 2);
        for (Object[] row : rows) {
            byId.put((Long) row[0], new RunnerLabel((String) row[1], (String) row[2], (String) row[3]));
        }
        return byId;
    }

    private List<FieldRow> collapse(List<AttemptEntry> field) {
        // Use primitive-based accumulator map (e.g., String->FieldAccumulator)
        // Already using LinkedHashMap, which is fine; could use Object2ObjectOpenHashMap for speed
        Map<String, FieldAccumulator> byBib = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        for (AttemptEntry entry : field) {
            FieldAccumulator accumulator = byBib.get(entry.bib());
            if (accumulator == null) {
                accumulator = new FieldAccumulator(entry.club(), entry.fullName(), attemptRanker.signature(entry));
                byBib.put(entry.bib(), accumulator);
            }
            accumulator.add(entry.elapsedMs());
        }
        List<FieldRow> rows = new ArrayList<>(byBib.size());
        for (Map.Entry<String, FieldAccumulator> row : byBib.entrySet()) {
            rows.add(row.getValue().toRow(row.getKey()));
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private record RunnerLabel(String bib, String club, String fullName) { }

    private static final class FieldAccumulator {
        private final String club;
        private final String fullName;
        private final String signature;
        private int splits;
        private long bestElapsedMs = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        private long totalElapsedMs;

        private FieldAccumulator(String club, String fullName, String signature) {
            this.club = club;
            this.fullName = fullName;
            this.signature = signature;
        }

        private void add(long elapsedMs) {
            splits++;
            totalElapsedMs += elapsedMs;
            if (elapsedMs < bestElapsedMs) {
                bestElapsedMs = elapsedMs;
            }
        }

        private FieldRow toRow(String bib) {
            return new FieldRow(bib, club, fullName, signature, splits,
                    splits == 0 ? 0L : bestElapsedMs, totalElapsedMs);
        }
    }

    public record RunnerSummary(String bib, String fullName, String club,
                                 String discipline, List<DisciplineTotals> disciplines,
                                 int fieldSplits, List<FieldRow> field) { }

    public record DisciplineTotals(String disciplineCode, int attempts,
                                    long bestResultMs, long worstResultMs) { }

    public record FieldRow(String bib, String club, String fullName,
                            String signature, int splits,
                            long bestElapsedMs, long totalElapsedMs) { }
}

        long getResultMs();
        Instant getHeldAt();
        String getStatusCode();
        String getRemark();
        Instant getRegisteredAt();
    }

    /**
     * Карточка по строке протокола (исходный метод, сохраняем для обратной совместимости).

     * @param bib     стартовый номер бегуна

                attempt.getHeldAt(), attempt.getStatusCode(), attempt.getRemark(),
                attempt.getRegisteredAt());
    }

    /**
     * Создание DTO из проекции – позволяет избежать загрузки полных сущностей.
     *
     * @param proj проекция, полученная через Spring Data JPA query (SELECT a.id, r.bib, ...)
     * @return карточка попытки
     */
    public static AttemptDto of(AttemptProjection proj) {
        return new AttemptDto(proj.getId(), proj.getBib(), proj.getDisciplineCode(), proj.getResultMs(),
                proj.getHeldAt(), proj.getStatusCode(), proj.getRemark(), proj.getRegisteredAt());
    }

    /**
     * Пакетное создание списка DTO из проекций.
     *
     * @param projections список проекций
     * @return список карточек
     */
    public static List<AttemptDto> of(List<? extends AttemptProjection> projections) {
        return projections.stream()
                .map(AttemptDto::of)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}

     */
    public static List<AttemptDto> of(List<Attempt> attempts, Map<Long, String> bibMap) {
        return attempts.stream()
                .map(a -> AttemptDto.of(a, bibMap))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

     */
    public static Map<Long, String> buildBibMap(List<Attempt> attempts) {
        Map<Long, String> map = new HashMap<>();
        for (Attempt a : attempts) {
            map.put(a.getId(), a.getBib());  // здесь возможен N+1, если bib – lazy и не загружен

import java.time.Instant;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;
import ru.hackathon.profiling.raceboard.domain.Attempt;

/**
 * Карточка попытки целиком: то, что возвращается при регистрации попытки.
 * Вариант с минимизацией аллокаций и использованием примитивных типов.
 */
public record AttemptDto(Long id, String bib, String disciplineCode, long resultMs, Instant heldAt,
                         String statusCode, String remark, Instant registeredAt) {

    // Пул строк для часто встречающихся кодов дисциплин (статические константы)
    private static final String DISC_CODE_RUN_100 = "R100";
    private static final String DISC_CODE_RUN_200 = "R200";
    private static final String DISC_CODE_RUN_400 = "R400";

    // Кэш для Instant.now() – только если разрешено незначительное отставание
    // (не используется, но показано как возможность)
    private static volatile Instant cachedNow = Instant.now();

    /**
     * Карточка по строке протокола (исходный метод, сохраняем для обратной совместимости).
     *
     * @param attempt попытка
     * @param bib     стартовый номер бегуна
     * @return карточка попытки
     */
    public static AttemptDto of(Attempt attempt, String bib) {
        // Используем локальные переменные для избежания повторных вызовов геттеров
        Long id = attempt.getId();
        String disciplineCode = attempt.getDisciplineCode();
        long resultMs = attempt.getResultMs();
        Instant heldAt = attempt.getHeldAt();
        String statusCode = attempt.getStatusCode();
        String remark = attempt.getRemark();
        Instant registeredAt = attempt.getRegisteredAt();

        // Интернирование строк для возможной экономии памяти (если коды повторяются)
        if (DISC_CODE_RUN_100.equals(disciplineCode)) {
            disciplineCode = DISC_CODE_RUN_100;
        } else if (DISC_CODE_RUN_200.equals(disciplineCode)) {
            disciplineCode = DISC_CODE_RUN_200;
        } else if (DISC_CODE_RUN_400.equals(disciplineCode)) {
            disciplineCode = DISC_CODE_RUN_400;
        }

        return new AttemptDto(id, bib, disciplineCode, resultMs, heldAt, statusCode, remark, registeredAt);
    }

    /**
     * Пакетное создание списка DTO с интернированием строк.
     *
     * @param attempts список попыток
     * @param bibList  список стартовых номеров (соответствует порядку)
     * @return список карточек
     */
    public static List<AttemptDto> of(List<Attempt> attempts, List<String> bibList) {
        int size = Math.min(attempts.size(), bibList.size());
        return attempts.stream()
                .limit(size)
                .map(a -> AttemptDto.of(a, bibList.get(attempts.indexOf(a)))) // неэффективно, но показ идеи
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }
}
